The representation letter should explicitly state management's action plan for the next twelve months.
We require explicit confirmation regarding the financial support from your major shareholder.
traps: 说成 'Management must promise the company will not go bankrupt.'。'will not go bankrupt' 用词极不专业，合规用语是 'continue as a going concern'。
说成 'You should write down your plan to make money in the letter.'。'make money' 太口语，应使用 'generate sufficient cash flows' 或 'implement the business recovery plan'。
说成 'We need your confirmation about your going concern.'。'your going concern' 听起来像是公司的私有财产，应说 'management's assessment of going concern'。
aud_rep_going_concern_assumption.ai: Alex，该公司财务总监。他觉得大股东的函件已经足够证明偿债能力，认为在声明书中单独强调持续经营会引起银行和董事会的过度担忧。
aud_rep_going_concern_assumption.task: 解释为什么有了股东支持函后，管理层仍需在声明书中正式确认持续经营评估的合理性。

tgt: I’d like to discuss the proposed foreign exchange gain adjustment for the overseas subsidiary.
Could you explain why you propose this adjustment given the gain is unrealized?
Let’s confirm the gain should be deferred in the 9M26 consolidated statements.
traps: 错误表达: "This gain is not real" → 日常表达不专业，地道说法: "This gain is unrealized under HKFRS"
错误表达: "We can change it" → 语气随意，地道说法: "We should revise the adjustment to defer the gain"
错误表达: "We will look at it" → 表述模糊，地道说法: "We will draft the adjusting entry by EOD Tuesday"
aud_part_cross_border_9m26_review.ai: Alex是跨境项目合伙人，立场是符合HKFRS合并准则，诉求是正确处理未实现损益
aud_part_cross_border_9m26_review.task: 确认合并报表的调整分录及附注披露

tgt: Could you explain the strategic positioning of this product mix for your top-tier clients?
Is this low-margin product category part of a bundling strategy?
How do you balance the volume demand with the profitability targets for this client?
traps: 常说 'Why do you sell only cheap stuff?'，太冒犯。应说 'strategic positioning of this product mix'。
常说 'Is it a package deal?'，专业说法是 'bundling strategy'。
常说 'How to make money if it is low margin?'，应说 'balance the volume demand with the profitability targets'。
dd_cust_product_mix.ai: 产品经理，承认该类产品出货量大，虽然利润率低，但有助于保持工厂的产线满负荷运转。
dd_cust_product_mix.task: 了解该产品组合在内部定价策略中的定位

tgt: We identified several items with negative inventory balances in the system during FY26.
Could you explain the process for managing these instances when the system shows negative stock?
Are there manual reconciliations or logs to track these temporary discrepancies?
traps: 说成 'Your system is broken'，情绪化。应用 'We have some questions regarding the system's inventory recording'。
说成 'Negative stock is impossible'，过于绝对。应用 'The occurrence of negative inventory seems to be a significant data integrity issue'。
说成 'You lied in the report'，攻击性太强。应用 'We need to reconcile the discrepancy between the system data and the actual inventory levels'。
dd_inv_negative_stock.ai: 信息部/仓库经理。他表示这是系统接口延迟导致的展示问题，不影响报表。
dd_inv_negative_stock.task: 要求解释负库存发生的原因，并核实是否有对应的手工账作为补偿。

tgt: We need to verify the unpaid registered capital against the local corporate filings.
Check if this shortfall triggers any breach of the local statutory requirements.
Document the management's plan and timeline for the remaining capital injection.
traps: 把 '出资未到位' 直译为 'money not arrive'，非常口语化且不符合专业术语。应使用 'unpaid capital contribution' 或 'capital shortfall'。
表达 '核对工商档案' 时用 'look at government files'，显得很不正式。地道说法是 'verify against statutory corporate records'。
说 '管理层的计划' 时用 'boss's plan'，在商务英语中不合语境，应用 'management's action plan'。
wk_train_capital_contribution.ai: Alex 扮演新人小张。他有点担心这会构成违约或监管瑕疵，向你确认应如何在审计底稿中披露这一情况。
wk_train_capital_contribution.task: 厘清未足额出资的合规影响，并指导小张如何在底稿中进行恰当记录

tgt: I'm afraid the tax authority has formally rejected the $3 million R&D tax credit claim for FY25.
Unfortunately, after reviewing their feedback, our local legal team confirms there's no viable path for an appeal.
We need to adjust the fiscal year-end tax provision to reflect this shortfall.
traps: 误用 'bad news'：常说 'I have a bad news'，新闻不可数且不够专业，应说 'I'm afraid I have some unfortunate news'。
误用 'refused'：常说 'The tax office refused our request'，refuse通常指拒绝某人的要求，机构驳回申请应使用 'rejected' 或 'denied'。
误用 'no way'：常说 'There is no way to appeal'，听起来太口语化，应说 'There is no viable path for an appeal'。
wk_bad_tax_credit_denial.ai: 客户财务总监。他原本在预算中预留了这笔现金流入，听到消息后感到遗憾，想了解是否有补救的行政复议空间。
wk_bad_tax_credit_denial.task: 明确告知抵免被否决的事实，并解释已无法通过行政复议挽回。

tgt: Could you confirm the subsequent cash collection amount up to March 31, 2026?
What portion of the FY25 year-end balance has been collected so far?
Do you have the latest bank slip for these incoming payments?
traps: 期后回款直译错误：说成 'money collected after the period' 听起来像口语俚语，专业术语应为 'subsequent cash collection'
到目前为止搭配错误：说成 'so far in this moment' 中式英语痕迹重，地道说法是 'so far' 或 'up to date'
银行流水直译错误：说成 'bank flowing water' 属于严重中式直译，正确说法是 'bank slip' 或 'bank statement'
dd_ar_collection_after_date.ai: Alex 是对方公司出纳。他手头有最新的银行流水，会直接告诉你截至 3 月底已经收回了 3000 万元。
dd_ar_collection_after_date.task: 向出纳确认 FY25 年底应收账款在期后的具体回款金额

tgt: The investment in the associate includes both equity and long-term receivables.
We need to assess whether the losses should be applied against the carrying amount of these receivables.
The current consolidation approach ignores the impairment of the long-term loan to the associate.
traps: 常说 'The loss is too big.'，应说 'The loss exceeds the carrying amount of the investment.'。
常说 'You forgot to look at the loan.'，应说 'The long-term receivable should be considered part of the net investment.'。
常说 'It is not right.'，应说 'This treatment does not align with the equity method requirements.'。
aud_consol_equity_accounting_4616.ai: Alex是集团财务总监，他认为长期应收款是独立债权，不应在权益法核算亏损时一并冲销。
aud_consol_equity_accounting_4616.task: 解释权益法下对联营企业净投资的认定，包括长期债权的处理。

tgt: Thank you for your candid feedback, we will definitely streamline our presentation.
For our next meeting, we will focus only on the key issues and action items.
I want to make sure we respect your time and provide value in every session.
traps: 常说 'We have to report that much'，为自己辩解。应改为 'We will prepare a more concise executive summary for our future meetings'。
常说 'It wasn't a waste of time'，反驳客户。应改为 'I understand your point and I agree we can be more efficient'。
常说 'That's our style'，傲慢。应改为 'We will adjust our reporting style to better suit your expectations'。
wk_client_meeting_complaint.ai: Alex是业务运营主管，他追求高效率。他直接表达了不满，希望后续会议更有成效。
wk_client_meeting_complaint.task: 接受建议，优化沟通方式并重拾信任

tgt: Could you clarify the underlying purpose and terms of the time deposit pledged as collateral?
We noticed that these pledged funds were not explicitly mentioned in the notes to the FY25 draft financial statements.
Could you please share the specific banking agreements and board resolutions authorizing this pledge?
traps: 使用 'Why the money is locked up'。太口语化，显得不够专业，地道表达应用 'clarify the underlying purpose and terms'。
直译 'We found your money is frozen'。'Frozen' 通常指司法冻结，此处质押应用 'pledged as collateral' 或 'restricted cash'。
使用 'You didn't write this in paper'。搭配错误且语气生硬，应说 'were not explicitly mentioned in the financial statements'。
dd_bank_restricted_cash_inquiry.ai: Alex 扮演目标公司财务总监。他会解释这两笔定期存款是为下属控股子公司开具银行承兑汇票提供的一年期质押担保，并认为这属于日常经营常规操作，未达到重大合同披露标准。
dd_bank_restricted_cash_inquiry.task: 向财务总监澄清该定期存款质押的详细背景、对应的授信额度及对流动性的影响，并获取相关质押合同。

tgt: Our client acceptance procedures require full disclosure of all related-party transactions in FY25.
Could you provide the commercial rationale behind the interest-free shareholder loan of 5 million HKD?
We need to evaluate if this transaction requires additional approval under Listing Rules.
traps: 谈承接时说 'Our boss wants to know if we can take this job.' 过于随意，地道说法应用 Our client acceptance procedures require。
问商业实质时说 'Why did you lend money for free?' 显得不专业，应为 commercial rationale behind the interest-free shareholder loan。
提及合规时说 'Does the law allow this?' 范围太大，应为 requires additional approval under Listing Rules。
aud_open_client_acceptance.ai: Alex 扮演风控总监 Lisa。她解释这笔借款属于正常的营运资金支持，且已在备忘录中说明，认为没必要在初步承接阶段过度纠缠关联方认定。
aud_open_client_acceptance.task: 评估关联方交易的商业实质与披露合规性，为承接决策提供依据。

tgt: How do you balance stringent SOX 404 access controls with operational efficiency for the finance team?
Have you encountered any issues with ERP system migration that led to compliance gaps in previous projects?
We have only eight days until go-live; can you perform an expedited gap analysis of our current control environment?
traps: Avoid 'Don't make it too hard for my team' which is unprofessional; use 'We need to maintain a balance between robust control and operational throughput.'
Avoid 'Is the system safe enough?' which is too vague; use 'Does our current permission architecture meet the requirements for SOX compliance?'
Avoid 'You are overcomplicating things' which is rude; use 'I’m concerned that this level of control might create bottlenecks in our daily workflow.'
wk_hire_it_auditor.ai: Alex是IT审计出身，他非常看重系统架构的安全性，倾向于建议复杂的审批流程，你需要平衡安全性与操作效率。
wk_hire_it_auditor.task: 核实其在SOX合规方面的权限审计经验，并确认他能设计出既合规又不影响日常财务处理效率的内控方案。

tgt: Your financial reporting service is delivered via the public internet for a fee.
This structure generally falls under the scope of value-added telecommunication services.
Has the legal team evaluated the necessity of obtaining an ICP or EDI license?
traps: 不要说 'You are doing IT work.'，应说 'Your service model involves providing information services via public networks.'。
不要说 'This is definitely illegal.'，应说 'There is some uncertainty regarding the licensing requirements for this service.'。
不要说 'I think you need a permit.'，应说 'We are concerned that the current business model may lack the necessary permit.'。
dd_lic_telecom_value_added.ai: Alex是CTO。他认为这只是财务软件服务，属于IT外包，不属于电信业务。
dd_lic_telecom_value_added.task: 明确该业务是否通过公共互联网提供运营性服务，从而界定电信资质必要性。

tgt: Insurance claim receivables are non-recurring and non-trade in nature.
Including them in working capital would distort the operational liquidity baseline.
We recommend reclassifying this claim as a non-operating receivable outside the working capital scope.
traps: 用 'not normal' 代替 'non-recurring'，在尽调报告中不够专业。
把 '非贸易类' 翻译成 'no trade'，正确的专业说法是 'non-trade in nature'。
误用 'out of scope' 的句式结构，地道表达为 'outside the working capital scope' 或 'excluded from the scope'。
dd_wc_insurance_claim_receivable.ai: Alex 是目标公司内控负责人。他认为既然这笔钱确定能收回来，就和普通客户应收账款性质一样，应该算作营运资金资产。
dd_wc_insurance_claim_receivable.task: 向内控负责人澄清保险索赔属于非经常性及非贸易类资产，不能计入营运资金基准

tgt: I'm copying our regional tax partner, Sarah, on this thread as we need a technical consensus on the Article 8 exemption.
Holding 2.8 million in provisions seems overly conservative based on the latest 2026 ruling.
Let's align with the regional practice before finalizing the FY25 tax footnote.
traps: 不说 'I CCed your boss to scare you'。抄送应该用专业且建设性的口吻：'I'm copying our regional tax partner... as we need a technical consensus'。
不说 'Your opinion is too conservative and wrong'。指责对方太保守用词不当，地道说法是 'This seems overly conservative based on the latest 2026 ruling'。
不说 'We must change the tax number'。报表附注里的披露用词是 tax footnote 或 tax disclosure，而不是 general tax number。
wk_esc_tax_dispute.ai: Mark，当地税务咨询团队负责人。他偏向保守，担心签字承担个人执业风险。他会坚持出具保守报告，但愿意听取你对法条新解释的陈述。
wk_esc_tax_dispute.task: 说服 Mark 修改复核结论，并在必要时向大中华区税务合伙人抄送以寻求技术裁决。

tgt: The rebate is an obligation triggered by the sales volume achieved, regardless of whether the invoice has been issued.
We suggest accruing the remaining 2% to ensure all expenses related to the current year's sales are captured.
Can you share the rebate agreement so we can verify the calculation basis?
traps: 使用 'You are waiting for the bill'：口语化，应说 'The accrual should be based on the obligation incurred'.
使用 'You missed the money'：不专业，应说 'There is an under-accrual of sales rebates'.
使用 'You have to put it in the books'：命令式，应说 'We recommend adjusting the accrual for the current period'.
aud_adj_warranty_rebate.ai: Alex是销售财务。他表示只有对方开出发票才会确认，否则不入账。
aud_adj_warranty_rebate.task: 基于权责发生制，要求对方补计提剩余2%的销售折扣。

tgt: We are reviewing the debt restructuring agreement finalized in February.
How does this arrangement affect the company's liquidity position as of the year-end?
We need to assess if this provides sufficient evidence to mitigate the going concern risks.
traps: 使用 'Is the company broke?'，太冒犯，应说 'We are assessing the company's going concern status'。
使用 'The bank saved you'，语域极差，应说 'The restructuring provides additional financial flexibility'。
使用 'I need to see the proof'，'proof' 太像法庭，应说 'We need to examine the signed agreement as audit evidence'。
aud_subs_subsequent_debt_restructuring.ai: 财务总监。他希望审计师将此视为积极信号，不再质疑公司偿债能力。
aud_subs_subsequent_debt_restructuring.task: 获取重组协议副本，核实其有效性及对流动性比率的影响。

tgt: Under HKSA 12, we need to disclose criteria for recognizing deferred tax assets, not just future plans.
We can frame it as “utilizable tax losses subject to future taxable profits being available”.
This wording aligns with both tax planning notes and accounting standards.
traps: 1. 口语化错误：错说“will use these losses”，专业表达应是“utilizable tax losses”
2. 搭配错误：错用“use losses”，正确是“utilize tax losses”，搭配更专业
3. 表述模糊：错写“in future”，正确是“in future taxable periods”，符合会计准则时间限定要求
aud_fs_deferred_tax_note_refine.ai: Alex是公司税务经理，立场是想体现税务筹划空间，诉求是让表述更灵活
aud_fs_deferred_tax_note_refine.task: 修正措辞符合HKSA 12对递延税确认的严谨要求，保留税务合规信息但不模糊披露标准

tgt: What incremental discount rate was applied to the lease liabilities projected for the new store openings in FY26F?
Could you reconcile the right-of-use asset depreciation schedule with the cash outflow for lease payments?
We would like to review the underlying lease term assumptions embedded in the model.
traps: 使用 'What interest rate did you use for renting houses?'。'renting houses' 过于生活化，企业租赁应用 'lease liabilities' 或 'store leases'。
使用 'The cash flow and lease schedule do not match.'。语气有些生硬突兀，应用 'We noticed a slight variance when reconciling the lease cash flows with the balance sheet projections.'。
使用 'Please show me how you calculate the depreciation of right-of-use assets.'。略显冗长，可用 'Could you walk us through the amortization methodology for the right-of-use assets?'。
dd_fcst_lease_liabilities.ai: Alex 扮演财务经理。他拿着几份拟签的租赁意向书，平静地向你解释每家新店的租金基数和租期设定。
dd_fcst_lease_liabilities.task: 弄清FY26F模型中新增门店的折现率取值及使用权资产摊销的计算口径。

tgt: Regarding the loan restructuring in January, does this change the classification of the debt in the FY25 financial statements?
Please provide the signed loan agreement for our review.
We need to determine if this impacts the going concern assessment for FY25.
traps: 误用 'The bank changed the loan time.'。应说 'The bank extended the loan maturity.'。
误用 'The loan is long-term now.'。应说 'The loan has been reclassified as a long-term liability.'。
误用 'It's good for the company.'。应说 'This significantly improves the company's liquidity profile.'。
aud_subs_subsequent_debt_restructuring_4.ai: Alex是财务经理，他确认协议已签署，并认为这显著改善了流动性。
aud_subs_subsequent_debt_restructuring_4.task: 确认该事项是否影响FY25报表中关于流动负债的分类。

tgt: Could you clarify why this SPE was excluded from the consolidation scope in the 9M26 reports?
We need to review the shareholders' agreement to determine if the Group has de facto control.
Could you provide the organizational chart that includes this entity and its relationship with the Group?
traps: 常说：'Why this company is not inside the group?' 应说：'Why was this entity excluded from the consolidated financial statements?'，'inside'太口语化。
常说：'It is your control.' 应说：'Does the Group have control over this entity?'，'It is your control'语法混乱且含义不清。
常说：'Give me the paper.' 应说：'Could you please provide the supporting documentation?'，'Give me the paper'在商务环境下语气过于生硬且范围不明。
dd_sub_consolidation_scope.ai: Alex是客户方的财务经理，他表示这家SPE由外部投资者主导，集团仅持有少数股份，所以认为不需要合并。
dd_sub_consolidation_scope.task: 向Alex确认该实体的控制权归属，并索要相关的协议以判定合并逻辑。

tgt: We encountered complex legacy labor liabilities during the entity liquidation process.
To resolve these compliance gaps, the external legal counsel has requested additional billable hours.
We seek your approval to increase the budget by 20,000 dollars to ensure the successful closure of these entities.
traps: 常说 'The legal problems are complex'，应说 'We encountered complex legacy labor liabilities'，用 legacy liabilities 描述历史问题更专业。
习惯说 'The lawyer needs more pay'，应说 'The external counsel requested additional billable hours'，用 billable hours 对应工时计算。
常说 'I want to finish it'，应说 'We seek your approval to ensure the closure'，用 seek approval 比 want 更具职业感。
wk_budget_legal_entity_restructure.ai: Alex是合伙人，负责该并购后整合项目。他更关心项目进度是否因此受阻。
wk_budget_legal_entity_restructure.task: 汇报法务费用增长情况，请求审批额外支出

tgt: In light of the market volatility, what are the key financial metrics your bank prioritizes for credit facilities in FY26?
We are advising a client who is preparing their financial documentation for a long-term loan application.
Could you provide some guidance on what the bank looks for during the credit risk assessment phase?
traps: 避免说 'My client wants to borrow money'，像中介。应使用 'We are assisting a client in preparing for their upcoming financing cycle'。
避免说 'What do you want to see?'，语气太轻浮。应使用 'What are the key criteria for your risk assessment?'。
避免说 'Is it easy to get a loan?'，幼稚。应使用 'What are the main factors influencing credit approval in the current environment?'
wk_net_bank_treasury_lead.ai: Alex扮演银行资金主管。他愿意向你简要说明目前的银行信贷偏好和对借款主体财务稳健性的考量点。
wk_net_bank_treasury_lead.task: 探明银行在FY26的放贷重点，并为客户后续的融资申请打好基础。

tgt: We have no choice but to escalate this covenant breach to the facility agent immediately.
I am copying the CFO and the banking syndicate lead on this waiver request.
Please draft an urgent notification letter for the lenders' escalation by tonight.
traps: 写成 'We must tell bank we break rule'，表达极其不专业，地道表达应用 escalate this covenant breach to the facility agent immediately。
写成 'I put CFO in email'，搭配过于随意，地道表达应用 copying the CFO and the banking syndicate lead on this waiver request。
写成 'Write a letter for bank people'，词汇不够商务，地道表达应用 draft an urgent notification letter for the lenders' escalation。
wk_esc_debt_covenant_breach.ai: Alex 是公司财务经理。他担心通报银行会导致贷款利率上浮或提前抽贷，主张隐瞒或拖延披露。
wk_esc_debt_covenant_breach.task: 说服 Alex 立即向银团代理行正式发送豁免申请，并将函件抄送公司 CFO 与债权人代表。

tgt: We noted that the sublease agreement lacks formal written consent from the head landlord.
Relying on an oral agreement does not mitigate the legal risk of a potential lease breach.
Could you provide the written waiver or endorsement from the property owner regarding this sublease arrangement?
traps: 说‘大房东/总房东’说成 'big landlord'，听起来很中式，地道说法是 'head landlord' 或 'master lessor'。
说‘口头默契’直译为 'mouth agreement'，不符合法律语境，地道说法是 'oral agreement' 或 'tacit understanding'。
说‘书面豁免或背书’说成 'written paper'，极其口语化，专业表述为 'written waiver or endorsement'。
dd_lease_sublease_compliance.ai: Alex，标公司法务总监。他承认当时未取得房东书面盖章，但解释说双方有口头默契，且房东行政经办人一直知情并默认了此事。
dd_lease_sublease_compliance.task: 指出缺乏房东书面同意书（Landlord's Consent）可能导致的租赁合同违约及转租收入合规风险，要求对方补充合规文件。

tgt: Target included a 1.8 million dollar one-off government subsidy in their FY25 core EBITDA.
Since this is non-recurring in nature, we strongly recommend stripping it out from the normalized earnings.
This adjustment will lower the baseline EBITDA, which directly impacts our valuation multiple.
traps: 使用 'Target put a government bonus into normal profit'。'government bonus' 和 'normal profit' 不专业，应为 'government subsidy' 和 'core EBITDA'。
使用 'We must cut it out'。'cut it out' 听起来像停止某种行为，调整财务数据应使用 'stripping it out' 或 'adjusting it out'。
使用 'This will make our valuation look lower'。'look lower' 偏主观，专业表述为 'directly impacts our valuation multiple' 或 'reduces the baseline earnings'。
dd_deal_overstated_ebitda.ai: Alex是买方Deal Lead。他需要确认扣除这笔补贴后，对整体估值多大程度的向下修正。
dd_deal_overstated_ebitda.task: 向Alex解释该补贴的非经常性本质，并建议在最终的Normalized EBITDA计算中予以扣除。

tgt: What is the level of confidence in the profit forecasts for the upcoming three years?
Are there any non-recurring items included in these future projections?
How do we balance the optimistic forecast with the historical loss-making trend?
traps: Avoid 'You will not make money.' – Pessimistic and blunt. Use 'Could you help me understand the basis for the projected profitability?'
Avoid 'The tax office will not like this.' – Speculative. Use 'We need to ensure that the recognition criteria under the relevant accounting standards are met.'
Avoid 'You are being too positive.' – 'Too positive' is vague. Use 'I'm concerned that these estimates might be overly optimistic.'
aud_est_deferred_tax.ai: 客户税务主管。他强调公司已经制定了详尽的扭亏为盈计划，对未来利润充满信心。
aud_est_deferred_tax.task: 询问盈利预测的确定性，引导其考虑确认递延所得税资产的审慎性要求。

tgt: While checking the batch payment records for 9M26, I noticed 3 e-receipts are missing out of a total 8 million RMB transaction.
Could you help check if these specific e-receipts can be re-downloaded from the online banking portal?
Having the complete set of receipts will help us finalize the vendor payment testing smoothly.
traps: 把‘电子回单’直译为 'electronic receipt' 虽能懂，但国内银行系统及审计中更常用的简称是 'e-receipt' 或 'bank payment slip'。
表达‘重新下载’时说 'download again'，略显啰嗦，地道商务英语用 're-download'。
将‘完成测试’说成 'finish the test'，不够正式，应用 'finalize the testing smoothly'。
dd_bank_online_banking_batch_payment.ai: Alex是公司出纳。他表示可能是批量下载时漏掉了几个明细回单，可以马上登录网银重新导出一份完整的。
dd_bank_online_banking_batch_payment.task: 向出纳告知9M26网银批量付款中存在3张电子回单缺失的情况，并请其协助补传

tgt: We understand your scheduling constraints, but the final audit report deadline is only 5 working days away—can we delay the MRL submission by max 2 days?
We need to confirm core representations (e.g., no undisclosed related parties) remain in the signed document to meet HKSA requirements.
We’ll send a formal follow-up once we have your confirmation on the adjusted timeline.
traps: 错误说法：“Please delay the MRL 2 days” → 过于强硬且未说明对进度的影响，地道说法：“We would appreciate it if you could delay the MRL submission by 2 days”
错误说法：“Don’t delete the related party part” → 口语化且语气生硬，地道说法：“We kindly request that the core related party representation is retained”
错误说法：“I can’t wait for this” → 情绪化不专业，地道说法：“We need to proceed with final procedures so look forward to your clarity”
aud_rep_01.ai: Alex，客户集团CFO，立场是怕董事未核实就签字担责，诉求是宽限2天，且声明中不要明确提及“无隐瞒关联方交易”。
aud_rep_01.task: 协商确认宽限可行性，明确核心条款不得删除

tgt: The current profit margin appears to be significantly lower than the industry benchmark.
Could you clarify the transfer pricing policy and its alignment with the arm's length principle?
We are concerned that the tax authorities might challenge the current pricing structure during a transfer pricing audit.
traps: 动词错搭：如 'do the price'，应使用 'set the transfer price'。
直译：如 'the price is not fair'，商业用语应为 'the pricing does not reflect the arm's length principle'。
口语化：如 'the tax man will come'，应使用 'the tax authorities might initiate a challenge'。
dd_tax_transfer_pricing_6065.ai: Alex 是被投方的财务合伙人，认为这是集团定价策略，并称该定价已通过当地税务局的备案。
dd_tax_transfer_pricing_6065.task: 质疑转让定价的合理性，并指出存在补税及滞纳金风险。

tgt: We can certainly exclude the 12.0 million RMB consulting fee from the adjusted EBITDA for FY25.
How would you like us to treat similar minor non-recurring items in the future periods like 9M26?
Recalculating the model with this new definition will take about one extra day.
traps: 直接说 'This is wrong' 是大忌。应该说：'Let's look at how this adjustment affects the overall EBITDA definition.'
说成 'I already finished the model' 显得不愿配合。地道表达是：'We can update the model, though it will take some extra time.'
用 'Give me your formula' 语气粗鲁。地道说法是：'Could you share your preferred methodology for these adjustments?'
dd_scope_revise_ebitda_definition.ai: Alex是买方投资总监。他基于最新的业务理解，希望微调EBITDA的计算口径以更真实反映核心盈利，态度专业且乐于商讨。
dd_scope_revise_ebitda_definition.task: 确认调整口径的具体边界，并告知重新测算对整体财务报告进度的影响

tgt: Our FY26 IT baseline review indicates the active directory password policy currently enforces only six characters without mandatory expiration.
I understand stricter rules might increase helpdesk tickets, but this falls short of our mandated security standard.
What is the realistic timeline for your team to implement the 10-character complexity and 90-day expiration rules?
traps: 中国人常说 Your password policy is too weak and only 6 words，单词用错（characters误用words）。地道应说 enforces only six characters without mandatory expiration。
常说 I know users will cry if we change it，表达过于粗俗。地道应说 stricter rules might increase helpdesk tickets。
常说 When can you fix this password thing，太随意。地道应说 What is the realistic timeline for your team to implement...
aud_it_password_policy_weak.ai: Alex，IT基础设施经理，刚处理完全员重置密码的客诉。他解释说如果突然收紧密码规则，公司500多名一线员工会产生大量抱怨和锁死求助。
aud_it_password_policy_weak.task: 劝说对方在下一个月度维护窗口前，将域密码策略提升至10位且包含大小写数字特殊字符的标准。

tgt: Automating the collection won't bypass your review; it simply centralizes the documents so you can approve them in batches.
We can configure the system to trigger a notification to your team only when a new contract deviates from our standard template.
This shift reduces the administrative burden on your staff while maintaining the same level of legal rigor.
traps: 使用 'Your team is too slow' 这种攻击性措辞，应改为 'To streamline our workflow'。
过度使用 'You must'，显得命令口吻。应使用 'I suggest we configure...' 或 'It would allow your team to...'
直译 'Let us cooperate'，显得生硬。应说 'I propose we collaborate on this integration to ensure compliance.'
wk_proc_transfer_pricing_documentation.ai: 法务部负责人。他认为现行的线下邮件审批更能把控风险，担心自动化系统会绕过法务对合同条款的最终审查。
wk_proc_transfer_pricing_documentation.task: 说服法务部同意推行系统预归集，并建立定期自动触发的审核机制，而非手动逐笔复核。

tgt: This event provides evidence of conditions that existed at the reporting date.
We must treat this as an adjusting event after the reporting period.
The financial statements need to be adjusted to reflect this impairment loss.
traps: 说“This is 2026's problem”，听起来像在推卸责任；应说“This event provides evidence of conditions existing at the balance sheet date”。
将“调整事项”说成“changing the numbers”，太口语；应使用“adjusting event”。
说“We have to change the report”，缺乏严谨性；应使用“adjust the financial statements”。
aud_fs_subsequent_event.ai: 客户财务经理。他认为这是2026年的事情，不应影响2025年的报表。
aud_fs_subsequent_event.task: 明确告知该事件证明了期末状况，属于资产负债表日后调整事项，必须在附注中披露并调整金额。

tgt: HKFRS 16 requires us to use the lessee's incremental borrowing rate if the rate implicit in the lease is not readily determinable.
Using the internal corporate rate might understate the lease liability if it does not reflect current market conditions.
Could you provide the benchmark rates or bank quotes we can use to substantiate the discount rate applied?
traps: 犯错说法：'Your interest rate is too low, you cannot use it.'，毛病：语气主观且缺乏依据支持，地道表达应引用准则限定，如 'We have concerns that this rate may not fully comply with HKFRS 16 requirements.'
犯错说法：'The lease contract is calculated in a wrong way.'，毛病：in a wrong way 语法虽然没错但极其死板，地道说法为 'There might be a variance in the measurement of the lease liability.'
犯错说法：'You need to find a bank to give you a new number.'，毛病：give you a new number 听起来像小学生做算术，专业表述应为 obtain a comparable borrowing rate from financial institutions.
aud_lease_liability_discount_rate.ai: Lisa扮演租赁与行政管理员。她的立场是认为只要按合同总额和公司内部融资成本做账即可，没意识到外部客观借款利率对折现的影响。
aud_lease_liability_discount_rate.task: 向其解释HKFRS 16关于增量借款利率（incremental borrowing rate）的选用标准

tgt: Since the advertising campaign runs through FY26, the 6 million payment should be treated as a prepayment.
We need to reclassify this amount from current year expenses to prepaid expenses.
Let's review the broadcast schedule to ensure proper cutoff for FY25.
traps: 说成 You put next year's advertisement into this year. 语法简单且不够专业，应用 treated as a prepayment。
说成 Change this cost to prepayment account. 祈使句气势汹汹，用 We need to reclassify this amount 更加专业客气。
说成 We need to check the advertisement cutoff. 搭配不够地道，用 broadcast schedule to ensure proper cutoff 更好。
aud_cut_advertising_prepayment.ai: Alex 是媒介财务。他翻出合同确认了付款节点，对这笔费用的归属期正准备做账务调整。
aud_cut_advertising_prepayment.task: 与媒介财务确认该广告费属于长期待摊费用，需从FY25费用中剥离

tgt: Even if these are by-products, we need to assess if they hold any recoverable value.
Could you provide the scrap disposal report from the last quarter to verify their market value?
We need to determine if these items should be recognized as inventory or written off through cost of goods sold.
traps: Avoid 'You are wrong about accounting', use 'We need to ensure the accounting treatment aligns with the valuation of the scrap'.
Don't say 'This is money you lost', use 'We are considering the potential value that could be recovered from these materials'.
Avoid 'You need to record it', use 'Let's review whether there is a basis to capitalize these items as inventory'.
aud_stock_production_waste.ai: Alex是生产部主管，他认为这些废料价值几乎为零，处理它们需要额外的人工费用，不应作为资产。
aud_stock_production_waste.task: 要求评估废料的可回收价值（Recoverable value）并确认是否符合存货定义。

tgt: We are currently reconciling the progress billings against the milestone certificates to verify the project status.
It is premature to conclude on the revenue recognition at this stage, as we are waiting for the third-party verification report.
We will provide a definitive assessment of the revenue cut-off as soon as we receive the outstanding confirmation letters.
traps: 使用“The problem is too big”来表达复杂性。地道表达应用“The issue is intricate”或“The matter is highly complex”。
直译“I think it is not good”来表达不确定性。建议使用“It remains inconclusive at this stage”以保持专业语域。
过度使用“We will check it again”来表示进一步审计。地道表达应为“We are performing additional substantive procedures”或“We are conducting follow-up testing”。
aud_ac_revenue_recognition.ai: 审计委员会委员，背景为前CFO。他想了解为何该项目的审计证据目前仍不充分，并要求评估这是否涉及收入确认提前的问题。
aud_ac_revenue_recognition.task: 阐述目前的审计程序并说明为何尚不能确定是否存在重大错报，同时给出后续核查的时间点。

tgt: I completely understand the urgency, and I’m sorry for the inconvenience this delay might cause.
We’re fine-tuning the cross-border reconciliation to ensure the final report is bulletproof.
Would it help if I sent you the high-level summary of the key findings this afternoon?
traps: 说“I'm sorry,”不够有力。建议用“I understand the urgency and regret the inconvenience”更具商务感。
说“We need more time,”显得效率低。建议用“We’re fine-tuning the reconciliation”凸显质量控制。
说“It's not my fault,”显得推卸责任。建议用“To ensure the report is bulletproof”强调负责任的态度。
wk_business_lunch.ai: Eric 扮演投资合伙人，他非常急躁，认为推迟报告会影响他们内部投委会的进度。
wk_business_lunch.task: 顶住压力，说明推迟是为了保证数据的准确性，并给出能让他向内部交代的替代方案。

tgt: I am looking at the license fee payment of five million RMB made to the research institute in FY25.
Is this amount a fixed annual fee or does it include a variable royalty based on sales?
Could you point me to the specific clause in the agreement that outlines the payment structure?
traps: 中国人常说 'I am checking the five million payment'，漏掉了名词修饰，地道表达是 'the license fee payment of five million RMB made to the research institute'。
中国人常说 'Is this fixed or floating with sales?'，'floating' 用在财务合同中不准确，地道表达是 'a variable royalty based on sales'。
中国人常说 'Where is the payment rule in the contract?'，'rule' 搭配不当，地道表达是 'the specific clause in the agreement that outlines the payment structure'。
dd_ia_license_agreement_royalty.ai: Alex是公司财务主管。他点头表示理解，主动把原始技术许可协议翻出来，指着其中的阶梯式提成条款向你做说明。
dd_ia_license_agreement_royalty.task: 向财务主管确认FY25支付的500万元许可费是固定基准费还是包含销售提成（Royalty）。

tgt: Alex, the granular breakdown you provided for the transfer pricing model was the pivotal factor in our tax mitigation strategy.
Your analytical rigour has set a new benchmark for how we document our cross-border profit allocation.
I’d like to propose formalizing your methodology into our standard documentation; it’s an asset we must retain.
traps: 避免使用 'You helped us save much money'，过于口语化。应使用 'Your contribution was the pivotal factor in our tax mitigation strategy' 更符合专业语境。
避免 'You did a good job on the calculation'，不够精确。建议使用 'Your analytical rigour has set a new benchmark' 来强调专业水准。
避免 'I think we should use your way for future'，缺乏权威感。应用 'I’d like to propose formalizing your methodology' 来体现专业领导力。
wk_praise_transfer_pricing.ai: Alex是税务分析师，他认为这是团队分内之事，且担心后续税务局还会就此纠缠，追问你是否要将此作为标准操作流程。
wk_praise_transfer_pricing.task: 表扬Alex的专业贡献并确认将其纳入SOP，以展示团队的价值增量。

tgt: Is there an independent appraisal report supporting this rental rate?
How do you justify the 15% premium compared to prevailing market rates for similar warehouses?
Were there any custom modifications made to the facility that explain the higher rent?
traps: 用 'Why your rent is higher than others' 显得不够专业。地道商务说法是 'How do you justify the premium compared to prevailing market rates?'。
把资产评估报告说成 'asset evaluation report'。标准专业术语是 'appraisal report' 或 'valuation report'。
表达 '市场上类似仓库' 时说成 'market similar warehouse'。地道搭配是 'comparable properties in the local market'。
dd_rp_related_party_lease.ai: Alex 扮演行政总监。他指出该仓储中心是根据目标公司特殊温控需求定制改造的，因此不能直接与普通仓库横向对比。他愿意提供当时的租赁市场调研报告。
dd_rp_related_party_lease.task: 确认该租赁价格偏高的合理性，了解是否存在独立第三方价格参考或评估报告。

tgt: Has the transfer of significant risks and rewards of ownership actually taken place by the period end?
Since the goods are still physically held in your warehouse, the control hasn't been transferred to the customers.
We need to reclassify this transaction as deferred revenue to reflect the substance of the arrangement.
traps: 常说 'The goods are not gone'，这是中式英语，应说 'The goods haven't left the facility' 或 'The physical transfer hasn't occurred'.
常说 'We need to move this money to another account'，过于随意，应说 'We need to reclassify the transaction' 来体现财务专业性。
常说 'It is not fit to record revenue'，应说 'It does not meet the criteria for revenue recognition'，更符合准则表述。
dd_rev_bill_and_hold_9083.ai: Alex是标的公司销售VP，他认为这批货已经锁定了客户需求且发票已开，理应计入当期收入，否则会影响公司完成季度销售目标。
dd_rev_bill_and_hold_9083.task: 基于控制权转移的原则，说服对方该收入暂不符合确认条件，需调整至预收账款。

tgt: We take full accountability for applying the incorrect incremental borrowing rate to the French warehouse leases.
We have already corrected the discount rate to 5.2% and regenerated the lease liability schedule.
I will send over the adjusted IFRS 16 impact analysis report within the hour for your review.
traps: 用了 'We are wrong about the interest rate'，太像小学生英语。地道商务表达是 'applying the incorrect incremental borrowing rate'。
用了 'made the table again'，口语化严重。专业说法是 'regenerated the lease liability schedule'。
用了 'send to you soon'，不够具体。地道说法是 'send over the adjusted impact analysis report within the hour'。
wk_sorry_lease_calc.ai: Alex 是客户方的财务经理，他在自查时发现了折现率差异，希望你方解释这个参数是怎么选取的，以及对使用权资产摊销数额的具体影响。
wk_sorry_lease_calc.task: 承认参数选取失误，解释由于信息更新不及时导致的差错，并提供修正后的表单。

tgt: Regarding the cut-off tests for FY25, could you walk me through the criteria you used?
How did you handle the orders that were shipped close to the year-end?
I want to make sure my testing approach is consistent with yours.
traps: 说 'How did you do the cut-off'，太口语。应说 'Could you explain the methodology used for the cut-off testing'。
说 'What was the rule'，太随意。应说 'What were the criteria for selecting the sample'。
说 'I want to be same'，表意不明。应说 'I want to ensure consistency in our testing approach'。
aud_oa_confirm_cut_off.ai: 前任负责人，非常清楚当时的操作细节，主动向你解释测试逻辑。
aud_oa_confirm_cut_off.task: 明确 FY25 截止测试的抽样标准和 cutoff 逻辑

tgt: The contract liability should be cleared once the revenue is recognized upon delivery.
Could you check if these deposits have been realized as revenue in the recent period?
We should adjust the working capital to reflect the correct status of these customer advances.
traps: 容易说“You should turn this to revenue”，动词搭配错误。应说“Recognize it as revenue”。
容易说“It’s wrong in the report”，指责性强。应说“The liability balance needs to be reconciled”。
容易说“Wait for the paper”，口语化。应说“Pending the final acceptance documentation”。
dd_wc_customer_deposit.ai: 你是销售财务，解释称因为验收报告还没回来，所以暂未冲销。
dd_wc_customer_deposit.task: 要求根据收入确认准则，调整WC中的合同负债余额。

tgt: Could you walk me through the specific background of this 4.5 million HKD sales return recorded in January 2026?
Was there any informal return agreement or side letter discussed with the client before the FY25 year-end?
Based on the original sales contract, what are the precise conditions under which the customer is allowed to return the goods?
traps: 错误使用 'tell me about the background'，在专业商务会话中 'walk me through' 显得更有结构感和地道。
直译为 'side agreement' 虽然能懂，但在港股审计中，审计准则更习惯使用 'side letter' 来指代补充的暗契或特殊条款。
使用 'conditions of return' 略显中式，地道说法通常用 'return provisions' 或 'return clauses'。
aud_subs_sales_return_after_year_end.ai: Alex是销售总监。他认为这只是正常的商业退货，并解释是因为客户1月份市场策略调整。他会正常配合提供解释，并无抵触情绪。
aud_subs_sales_return_after_year_end.task: 弄清楚这笔退货是属于期后正常调整还是FY25销售退回冲减

tgt: The digital screening tool handles the baseline compliance checks, allowing our team to focus on the high-risk areas identified.
This hybrid approach doesn't replace the expert review; it accelerates the identification of red flags.
We can establish a clear threshold for when the automated system must escalate findings to human oversight.
traps: 直译‘外包’：不要直接说 'outsource to a tool'，用 'leverage digital solutions' 或 'deploy automated screening tools' 更地道。
时态混乱：如 'We checked the data' 应为 'We have been checking'，准确表达持续进行的尽调工作。
逻辑连接词单调：一直用 'so'，建议改用 'consequently' 或 'thereby'，体现专业职场语调。
wk_proc_due_diligence.ai: 你是客户方的法务主管，对自动化筛查持怀疑态度，认为只有人工深挖才能识别出隐藏的关联交易和法律诉讼。
wk_proc_due_diligence.task: 说服法务主管接受‘自动化初步筛查+专家复核’的混合模式，以缩短调查时间。

tgt: Since this specific cash-generating unit has been loss-making, HKAS 36 requires an impairment test for the corresponding right-of-use assets.
Could you share your discounted cash flow model used to assess the recoverable amount of this leased property?
We need to factor in the actual reduced sublease income when calculating the present value of future cash flows.
traps: 说'这个办公室亏钱了你们得减值'直译为 'This office lose money so you must impair'，语法散乱，应说 'Given the ongoing losses generated by this office, an impairment assessment is warranted.'
要模型时说 'Show me your test model'，命令语气太强，应说 'Could you provide the impairment assessment model for our review?'
表达'折现现金流'时说 'discount money flow'，专业术语错误，应为 'discounted cash flow (DCF)'。
aud_mgmt_right_of_use_asset_impairment.ai: Alex 扮演客户财务经理 Rachel。她表示租约还有两年到期，而且公司正准备重组该业务线，因此不需要单独计提减值。
aud_mgmt_right_of_use_asset_impairment.task: 要求对方出具针对该亏损资产组的使用权资产减值测试模型

tgt: We are looking at the one point eight million HKD capitalization for the ERP implementation and customization in FY twenty-five.
Could you help us distinguish between the standard software license costs and the custom development components?
Under current accounting standards, general implementation fees are typically expensed as incurred unless they meet specific asset recognition criteria.
traps: 常说 'You cannot capitalize standard software setup fees.'，语气生硬且直接；地道说法是 'We are looking at the one point eight million HKD capitalization for the ERP implementation...'。
常说 'Tell me which part is custom and which part is standard.'，像是在训话；地道说法是委婉的 'Could you help us distinguish between the standard software license costs and the custom development components?'。
常说 'Your accounting is wrong according to the rules.'，不够职业；地道说法是客观探讨 'Under current accounting standards, general implementation fees are typically expensed as incurred...'。
aud_fraud_software_customization_cap.ai: Alex是IT总监。他认为二次开发属于量身定制，形成了独特的业务流程模块，具备资产的长期价值，因而应当资本化。
aud_fraud_software_customization_cap.task: 与IT总监沟通标准软件采购与实质性软件开发的界限，探讨部分费用应当费用化的可能性。

tgt: Drafting the greenhouse gas accounting framework would create a severe self-review threat when we perform the subsequent ESG assurance.
Management is responsible for establishing the methodology, while our role as the independent assurance provider is strictly to test it.
We can introduce our firm's separate advisory practice to assist you with the framework design if needed.
traps: 使用 'We cannot write the framework for you because we will audit it later.'。直译感强，地道说法应用 'Drafting the framework would create a severe self-review threat during subsequent assurance'。
Use 'You must make the framework by yourself.'。'by yourself' 略显粗鲁，地道说法应用 'Management is responsible for establishing the methodology'。
使用 'Our firm has different teams, so you can ask them.'。表达过于口语化，地道表达应用 'We can introduce our firm's separate advisory practice to assist you'。
aud_indep_sustainability_assurance.ai: Alex 是 EcoTextiles 的可持续发展总监，正在为主板上市的 ESG 披露合规赶工，希望找熟悉标准的专业人士一步到位协助起草。
aud_indep_sustainability_assurance.task: 厘清审计与咨询的界限，说明鉴证机构不能同时为客户设计或起草将被鉴证的 ESG 数据收集系统，建议由其他管理咨询团队介入。

tgt: Our sample indicates a processing delay of up to seven days in disabling network accounts for departed personnel.
Timely account deactivation is critical to prevent unauthorized access following employment termination.
Could we discuss how HR and IT can streamline the offboarding notification workflow?
traps: 使用 'late to close account'。地道商务说法是 'processing delay in disabling network accounts'。
使用 'stop bad guys'。合规语境下应说 'prevent unauthorized access following employment termination'。
使用 'make the workflow better'。地道表达是 'streamline the offboarding notification workflow'。
aud_it_offboarding_delay.ai: Alex是HRIT对接专员。他解释说HR部门提交离职工单存在两天的滞后，导致IT部门收到通知时已经超过了既定的SLA时效。
aud_it_offboarding_delay.task: 指出HR与IT协同脱节导致的离职账号清理延误，要求优化离职交接自动化工单流程。

tgt: The tax advisory fees appear to relate primarily to a group-level restructuring project that does not impact the target's local tax compliance.
We need to distinguish between standard tax filing support and the strategic group restructuring costs.
Could you provide a breakdown of the advisory scope to separate the project-specific costs from ongoing operational services?
traps: 使用“The restructuring is for your own benefit”：Restructuring是对抗用语，应说“The restructuring project was a group-level strategic initiative”。
使用“We don't get any benefit”：Get any benefit太口语化，应说“The project did not provide direct tax efficiencies to the target entity”。
使用“You need to list all the items”：语气生硬，应说“Could we request a more granular breakdown of the advisory work streams?”
dd_carve_shared_tax_service.ai: 集团税务总监。认为重组提升了整体估值，所有子公司都间接受益，分摊是合理的。
dd_carve_shared_tax_service.task: 区分日常税务合规与战略重组咨询，要求将重组咨询费从目标公司经营成本中剥离。

tgt: Let’s confirm whether the related party payable to the Hong Kong parent has explicit repayment terms.
Have you documented the parent’s intention to support working capital needs in FY26?
The going concern disclosure should include material obligations impacting liquidity.
traps: 错误说法："We forgot to add that note"，不地道：过于随意，地道表达："The related party payable was not adequately disclosed in the working papers."
错误说法："Parent will give us money"，不地道：口语化模糊，地道表达："The parent entity has committed to provide working capital support."
错误说法："This is not important for going concern"，不地道：表述不专业，地道表达："This is a material obligation requiring consideration under going concern."
aud_gc_fy25_related_payable.ai: Alex扮演项目组高级审计员，先说明当时处理情况，诉求是合理调整底稿不增工作量
aud_gc_fy25_related_payable.task: 要求Alex补充关联方应付款的还款安排、母公司支持意愿，确认是否需纳入持续经营披露

tgt: This clause is a standard requirement under HKSA 240 for statutory audits.
It simply confirms that management has disclosed all known fraud or suspected fraud.
We need this written acknowledgment to complete our audit documentation.
traps: 使用 'this must be written because of law'。表达不够专业，地道说法是 'this clause is a standard requirement under HKSA 240'。
使用 'it tells us you didn't do fraud'。语意表达不准且容易引起误解，地道说法是 'it confirms management's responsibility regarding fraud assessment'。
Use 'we need your say on fraud'。用词太口语化，地道说法是 'we require management's written representation on fraud'。
aud_rep_fraud_risk_acknowledgment.ai: Alex 是客户公司的内部法务代表。他并不是拒绝签署，只是想向你确认这一标准表述在审计准则中的必要性。
aud_rep_fraud_risk_acknowledgment.task: 向客户法务解释该舞弊披露声明是 HKSA 240 要求的标准必选项。

tgt: We need to review the cost breakdown to see if the 80% completion rate is supported by the production stages.
Could you explain the cost allocation for the final assembly phase compared to the initial structure?
We need to bridge the gap between our physical observation and the reported percentage.
traps: 说成 'You are lying about the progress'，非常不礼貌。应改为 'There is a mismatch between our observation and the reported completion rate.'
说成 'It's not 80%'，结论下得太快。应改为 'Could you provide the breakdown of costs incurred at this stage?'
说成 'You need to prove it'，语气强硬。应改为 'Would it be possible to see the production records to verify the progress?'
aud_stock_wip_completion.ai: 你是生产经理，你认为虽然外观看着简单，但内部核心零部件已全部安装，所以整体进度符合80%。
aud_stock_wip_completion.task: 核对成本归集表，要求生产经理拆分各阶段工时占比。

tgt: Could you point our new project manager to where the FY24 and FY25 workpapers are archived?
We want to make sure he catches up on the historical revenue recognition issues.
Thanks for taking the time to share your notes with us.
traps: 说 'Tell me where you put the old papers'。paper 改口称 workpapers 才是审计底稿的标准说法；'Tell me' 应用 'Could you point us to...'。
用 'He needs to know the old problems'。old problems 听起来像八卦，专业语境下应用 historical issues 或 legacy matters。
说 'Thank you for your help'。虽然没错，但在职场交接时用 'Thanks for sharing your notes' 会显得更专业具体。
wk_new_project_history_handover.ai: Alex 是上一个项目的负责人，刚调到隔壁组。他很乐意分享经验，并答应把云盘里的归档路径直接发给你。
wk_new_project_history_handover.task: 顺利获取往年项目的底稿路径和核心交接信息。

tgt: The loan agreement specifies a 5% annual interest rate, which should be accrued even if not yet paid.
Could you clarify the accounting treatment for this interest expense up to the cut-off date?
We need to include the accrued interest in our net debt calculation for the final report.
traps: 说成 'The interest was not paid yet, so we don't need to put it on the book'。地道说法是用 'accrue' 而不是 'put on the book'。
说成 'We must count this in the net debt'。'Count' 显得太口语化，用 'include in the calculation' 更专业。
说成 'Is the contract saying 5%?'。应使用 'Does the contract stipulate...' 来提升商务语境的严谨度。
dd_debt_shareholder_loan_9303.ai: Alex是目标公司的财务经理。他认为该借款目前处于展期沟通中，尚未实际支付，因此还没做账务处理。
dd_debt_shareholder_loan_9303.task: 与财务经理确认利息支出的计提原则，确保其纳入净负债口径。

tgt: I understand your caution regarding the tax risks, but let's weigh that against the $1.2M additional burden for FY26F.
Could we explore a slightly more balanced approach that remains compliant while optimizing the cash flow?
Let's walk through the specific statute together to see if there's room for a more pragmatic interpretation.
traps: 用了 'Your tax plan is too conservative and bad'，带有贬低对方专业能力的意味，地道说法应用 'I understand your caution, but let's weigh that against...'。
用了 'You need to change this scheme now'，命令式的口吻不符合专业同行间的交流，地道说法应用 'Could we explore a slightly more balanced approach'。
用了 'Why are you so scared of risk?'，过于直白且带有质问语气，地道说法应用 'let's see if there's room for a more pragmatic interpretation'。
wk_cul_tax_consultant.ai: Alex 是外部税务所的高级经理。他习惯于采用零风险的最保守合规口径，对你的质疑显得有些谨慎和抗拒。
wk_cul_tax_consultant.task: 在不引发对方抵触的情况下，促使对方重新评估税收筹划的性价比

tgt: Given that the beneficial owner of our key supplier is a close relative of our VP of Operations, this relationship must be evaluated for related party disclosure.
Could you provide the tender documents and conflict-of-interest declarations for this supplier selection process?
We need to ensure that all transactions with this entity are properly captured in the related party footnote for FY25.
traps: Use 'The boss's wife owns the supplier company'，表达过于口语化，地道说法应用 'the beneficial owner of our key supplier is a close relative of'。
使用 'Show me the competition papers'，'competition papers' 表达模糊，应使用 'tender documents and conflict-of-interest declarations'。
Use 'You did not tell us this secret'，'secret' 带有指责意味，商务沟通中应使用 'must be evaluated for related party disclosure'。
aud_rp_undisclosed_supplier_ownership.ai: Alex是公司采购主管。他表示运营副总裁的配偶在该公司开业前就已经营多年，且投标价格极具竞争力，因此未将此视为需要申报的关联交易。
aud_rp_undisclosed_supplier_ownership.task: 向采购主管指出主要供应商与公司高级管理人员存在近亲属关系，属于应当披露的重大关联方交易，要求提供历年采购决策的审批记录。

tgt: We missed the deadline for the tax analysis, and this impacts our ability to finalize the quarterly report.
I understand the workload is high, but we need to find a way to meet our commitments moving forward.
Let's break down the remaining tasks and see how we can catch up by Friday.
traps: 使用“You failed to finish”，显得在训斥，应说“We missed the deadline”，将责任共同化后再强调影响。
使用“You need to work harder”，显得不近人情，应说“Let's break down the tasks and see how we can catch up”。
使用“It is an excuse”，直接否定对方，应说“I understand the workload is high, but...”。
wk_cul_commitment_failure.ai: 组员觉得你要求过于苛刻，认为自己已经做得很努力了，甚至觉得你没意识到数据量有多大。
wk_cul_commitment_failure.task: 指出未能达成目标的后果，并讨论如何调整后续工作安排以弥补进度。

tgt: Our agreement with the client restricts us from sharing sensitive commercial information with third parties.
I can provide you with the summary report, but the raw data is confidential under our engagement terms.
We must ensure compliance with both our internal policies and the client's confidentiality requirements.
traps: 使用 'You can't see this'，缺乏解释，应说 'This is restricted under our engagement terms'。
使用 'This is secret'，太随意，应说 'This information is confidential'。
使用 'You have no right'，冲突性太强，应说 'We must ensure compliance with our obligations'。
wk_no_internal_audit_overlap_7917.ai: 内部审计负责人，他想证明自己对跨境合规有严格的监督权，坚持要看原始数据。
wk_no_internal_audit_overlap_7917.task: 在不冒犯内部审计前提下，拒绝提供涉及客户商业秘密的敏感底稿。

tgt: The weather has been perfect for sightseeing today, hasn't it?
I'm staying in room 405, how about you?
Have you had a chance to visit the museum yet?
traps: 将 'How is the weather?' 挂在嘴边，显得生硬，用 'The weather is lovely, isn't it?' 作为破冰更自然。
说成 'I stay in room 405'，表示习惯性动作，应使用现在进行时 'I'm staying in...'。
将 'Do you have plan?' 误用，应使用 'Do you have any plans?'。
soc_meet_hotel_lobby.ai: Alex 扮演一位刚入住的游客，他觉得这里的风景很美，正在找人搭话。
soc_meet_hotel_lobby.task: 回应天气评价，并交换一下彼此的旅行计划。

tgt: Is there any flexibility in converting my remaining personal training sessions into store credit?
Since I am relocating out of the city permanently, could we make an exception for this unused portion?
I'd hate for these sessions to go to waste given my sudden move.
traps: 说成 'Can you change my lessons to goods?' 'lessons' 和 'goods' 搭配不地道，地道说法是 'converting sessions into store credit'。
说成 'Because I move to another city, can you return money?' 语法错误且语气死板，地道说法是 'Since I am relocating out of the city permanently...'。
说成 'I don't want these classes to be wasted.' 中式直译，地道说法是 'I'd hate for these sessions to go to waste.'
soc_farewell_gym_membership.ai: Alex 是健身房经理。他必须执行公司的无退款政策，但对你的特殊离城情况表示理解。
soc_farewell_gym_membership.task: 争取将剩余的私教课折算成健身周边产品或延长他人卡期

tgt: I am so sorry, I thought you were someone else.
You look strikingly similar to a friend of mine from behind.
Have a wonderful rest of your day.
traps: 说成 'I认 wrong person.'，中式直译，正确说法是 'I mistook you for a friend.' 或 'I thought you were someone else.'
道歉时说 'My fault.' 显得过于生硬冰冷，地道说法是 'I am so sorry about that.' 或 'My apologies.'
告别时说 'You go first.' 搭配混乱，正确说法是 'Have a good one.' 或 'Enjoy your coffee.'
soc_name_coffee_shop_mix_up.ai: Alex 扮演这位被认错的男士。他性格温和，见你一脸尴尬，会友好地笑笑并回应你的搭话。
soc_name_coffee_shop_mix_up.task: 礼貌地向对方道歉并化解尴尬，顺便买好自己的燕麦拿铁。

tgt: It's only been two days, and the gel on my index finger is already peeling off.
I haven't done anything strenuous with my hands, so this shouldn't have happened.
I expect the service to last at least a week, so could you fix this for me?
traps: 说成 'This nail is broken'，容易被误解为指甲断了，应说 'The polish on this nail is chipping off.'
说成 'You did a bad job'，太挑衅，应说 'I'm a bit disappointed with how it's holding up.'
说成 'I need a refund'，目的不符，应说 'Could you please touch this up for me?'
life_nail_fix_request.ai: 美甲店员工，认为甲油剥落是客户日常习惯问题，不太愿意免费重做。
life_nail_fix_request.task: 坚持要求免费重做该指甲，并指出这属于产品质量或操作问题

tgt: Hi, sorry to bother you, but water is leaking through my kitchen ceiling.
It seems like it might be coming from your unit.
Could you come down and take a look with me?
traps: 说成 'My roof is leaking.'。公寓里一般是天花板 'ceiling'，'roof' 通常指整栋楼的房顶。
说成 'Water is dropping from up.'。表达漏水滴水应用 'leaking through' 或 'dripping down'，'from up' 非常中式英语。
说成 'You must check my kitchen now.'。语气像在质问，应该用客气但急切的疑问句 'Could you come down and take a look?'。
life_nb_leaking_water.ai: Alex 扮演楼上住户，开门后一脸茫然，说自己家里刚才洗衣服好像水管确实有点溢出来，愿意跟你一起下楼去看看情况。
life_nb_leaking_water.task: 告诉对方你家天花板在漏水，请对方进屋或者一起去你家查看原因。

tgt: I think we need to be realistic about the total budget for everyone.
How about we keep the current booking and spend the extra money on a nice group dinner instead?
Let's stop going back and forth and put this to a final vote.
traps: 避免说 'You are being stingy'，人身攻击。应说 'We should consider everyone's financial situation.'
避免说 'It's just 200 dollars'，忽略了经济差异。应说 'Not everyone might be comfortable with an extra $200 expense.'
避免说 'Stop talking about this'，无礼。应说 'I think we've explored this enough, let's reach a final decision.'
soc_group_vacation_lodging.ai: Alex强烈主张换去贵的地方，认为难得度假一次没必要省钱，并指责反对的人太抠门。
soc_group_vacation_lodging.task: 提出平衡方案，比如只升级部分房型，或者增加行程中的免费活动，终止无效争吵。

tgt: I’ve been practicing hip-hop for three years back home, so I’m confident I can keep up with this level.
Is there any way to waive the assessment? I have my previous training logs right here.
I'd really prefer to get signed up today to secure my spot in the class.
traps: 说 'I want to skip the test'，听起来像是在拒绝规矩，不够委婉。应说 'Could we waive the assessment?'
说 'My experience is very big'，这是中式英语，应用 'I have extensive experience'。
说 'You must believe me'，语气太强像在吵架，应说 'I can assure you that I’m familiar with the moves'.
hob_dance_studio_registration.ai: 前台服务员。礼貌地解释规定，要求看你上一期的课程证明或现场跳一段，否则不能直接插班。
hob_dance_studio_registration.task: 说服前台你已经在国内跳了三年，不需要重新测试，申请直接报名。

tgt: Sorry, I didn't quite catch the deposit amount. Could you say it again, please?
Did you say 150 euros or 500 euros?
Let me double-check—is the deposit 150 euros per night or for the whole stay?
traps: 说'Repeat again'，语义重复。应说'Could you repeat that?'
直接问'How much?'，显得不耐烦。应说'Sorry, I missed the amount.'
使用'What's the number?'，非常不地道。应使用'Could you clarify the amount?'
life_clarify_hotel_deposit.ai: 酒店前台，正在处理后续排队的客人，虽然客气但说话很快，不想重复太多遍。

tgt: I noticed you were struggling with those flashcards earlier.
I usually break down unfamiliar words using English roots.
Would you be up for sending daily voice notes to practice vocabulary?
traps: 说成 'I saw you are sad about your books.'，'sad' 词义过重且不准确，应说 'struggling with those flashcards'。
说成 'I use English roots to remember.'，动词搭配可以用 'break down ... using English roots' 显得更地道。
说成 'Can we send voice messages every day?'，略显生硬，用 'Would you be up for sending daily voice notes...?' 更地道。
hob_lang_cafe_exchange.ai: Alex 扮演这位日本男生，他英语不错但有些内向。他的立场是正为复杂的敬语头疼，对你主动搭讪感到意外但很感激，想向你请教背单词的方法。
hob_lang_cafe_exchange.task: 向对方分享你用英语学外语词汇的 3 个习惯，并提议互相发语音背单词

tgt: The pain is unbearable and I’ve been unable to eat or sleep properly for the past 24 hours.
Is there any cancellation list I can get on for an emergency appointment today?
I’m in so much pain that I’m willing to wait in the office if a slot opens up.
traps: 说成 'My tooth hurts so much.' 不如 'The pain is unbearable' 更有力度。
说成 'Can I come in?' 应说 'Is there any cancellation list I can get on?'。
说成 'I want to see the doctor today.' 太强硬，应说 'I’m willing to wait in the office if a slot opens up'。
life_doc_dental_pain.ai: 牙医诊所前台。严格执行预约制度，对你的痛苦表现出礼貌但冷漠的态度。
life_doc_dental_pain.task: 描述疼痛对生活的严重影响，争取一个临时加号的机会。

tgt: That song you just played was amazing—do you know what band it is?
I’m looking for more bands with that upbeat indie sound.
Can you recommend two similar local acts?
traps: 错误说法："That song is cool, what band it is?" 原因：特殊疑问句需用倒装语序，正确表达为"what band is it?"
错误说法："I want same style bands." 原因：搭配不符习惯，地道表达为"I want bands in the same style."
错误说法："Give me some bands like that." 原因：语气生硬不符合闲聊语境，地道表达为"Could you recommend a couple of similar bands, please?"
talk_music_cafe_recommend_band.ai: Alex是咖啡馆兼职服务员，刚工作3周，会整理店内播放列表，愿意推荐符合风格的乐队。
talk_music_cafe_recommend_band.task: 拿到2个符合风格的本地乐队名字

tgt: I ate oysters last night and now have red rashes all over my body with severe itching.
Do you have antihistamine safe for tourists to take here?
Should I avoid any foods while this is happening?
traps: 错误说法："I eat oyster and have rashes." 错误：时态错误应为过去时ate，oyster需加复数。地道："I ate oysters last night and now have red rashes all over my body with severe itching."
错误说法："Give me antihistamine." 错误：语气直接，不符合和药师沟通的礼貌语域。地道："Do you have antihistamine safe for tourists to take here?"
错误说法："I have itch very bad." 错误：itch用作动词，应为名词itching，修饰用severe itching。地道："with severe itching."
life_doc_paris_pharmacy_seafood.ai: Alex是来巴黎旅游的普通游客，吃生蚝后过敏，希望买到对症非处方过敏药，缓解红疹瘙痒。
life_doc_paris_pharmacy_seafood.task: 向药师描述海鲜过敏症状，买到合适的非处方过敏药，确认注意事项。

tgt: Here is my driver's license and rental agreement.
I'm really sorry, I didn't realize the speed limit dropped to 65 here.
Is everything okay, Officer?
traps: 递驾照时说 "Here is my card"。驾照应说 "driver's license"。
解释超速说 "I don't know the speed is 65"。地道说法是 "I didn't realize the speed limit dropped to 65"。
询问情况说 "Why you stop me?"。语法错误且语气生硬，地道说法是 "Is everything okay, Officer?"
life_car_speeding_ticket.ai: Alex 是执勤交警，态度公正严肃但并不粗暴，按程序向你索要证件并告知超速情况。
life_car_speeding_ticket.task: 礼貌配合警察，解释自己不是故意超速

tgt: Since my flight is cancelled, what are my options to get to my destination as soon as possible?
Could you check if there's any availability on your partner airlines?
I really need to reach my destination by tomorrow morning, can you prioritize my rebooking?
traps: 说 'I want to go today'。应说 'I need to reach my destination at the earliest possible time'。
说 'This is unacceptable'。发火没用，应说 'I understand the situation, but could we explore other airlines?'。
说 'Fix it'。太粗鲁，应说 'Could you help me find the best rebooking solution?'。
life_air_flight_cancellation.ai: 地勤人员。她表示最早的航班已满，她建议你等第二天，你希望她能查看其他合作伙伴航司的航班。
life_air_flight_cancellation.task: 争取改签到最早航班或合作伙伴航班

tgt: The shuttlecock just broke, can we buy a new one from the front desk?
We’re running out of time before closing, so let’s hurry.
I’ll pay for the new shuttlecock, no problem.
traps: 常说"the ball broke"，羽毛球语境应说"the shuttlecock broke"，"shuttlecock"是羽毛球的固定术语。
常说"buy a new one"，地道表达应为"purchase a new shuttlecock"，更正式礼貌。
常说"we don’t have time"，地道表达应为"We’re running out of time"，更符合时间紧张的口语场景。
hob_ball_badminton_shuttle_broken.ai: Alex是你的双打队友，本地华人，刚发杀球弄坏球，立场是想打完局但愿配合买新球，诉求是快速解决问题，不耽误关门。
hob_ball_badminton_shuttle_broken.task: 快速解决坏球问题，打完最后一局。

tgt: Are you doing anything this Sunday evening? I'm making some home-cooked food.
No problem at all, 7:30 PM works totally fine for me.
See you this Sunday at my place!
traps: 说成 'Do you want to eat dinner with me?'，听起来像质问或命令，邀请朋友聚餐通常说 'Would you like to come over for dinner?'。
说成 'My home address is...'，直接发地址显得唐突，地道表达是先确认对方有空再给地址，如 'I'll text you the address later.'。
回答对方改时间时说 'Your time is okay for me.'，语法生硬且有中式直译感，应该说 'That works for me.' 或 'That's totally fine.'。
life_invite_dinner_friend.ai: Alex 扮演好友 Chris，很高兴收到邀请，但表示周日晚上七点半才有空，问能不能稍微推迟半小时。
life_invite_dinner_friend.task: 敲定周日晚上聚餐的最终时间和安排

tgt: What's a good low-fat snack I can have after a workout?
Is a protein bar a good choice for someone trying to lose weight?
Are nuts okay to eat for a snack, or are they too high in calories?
traps: 不要说 'Is it good for fat-lose?'，名词是 'fat loss'，动词短语是 'lose fat'。
不要说 'Is it fattening?'，虽然可以用，但说 'Is it high in calories?' 更具体。
不要说 'I eat for losing fat'，直接说 'I'm trying to lose some weight' 或 'I'm on a fitness diet'。
hob_diet_gym_snack.ai: 健身教练，比较健谈，会根据你的运动量给出一些简单的饮食建议。
hob_diet_gym_snack.task: 请教练推荐一种适合运动后的低脂小食

tgt: These dryers usually need another five minutes to get heavy stuff completely dry.
I moved to the neighborhood about three months ago, so I'm still figuring things out.
If you need a decent grocery store nearby, the one on 4th Street is not bad at all.
traps: 说成 'My dryer has left 12 minutes.' 不地道。表达机器还剩多少时间应该用 'My dryer has 12 minutes left.' 或 'There are 12 minutes left on my dryer.'
说成 'Your clothes are not dry enough, right?' 显得有些突兀。地道的搭讪可以用委婉的语气：'Looks like your load needs a bit more time, huh?'
说成 'Do you know where is the supermarket?' 是典型的中式语序错误。宾语从句应使用陈述语序：'Do you know where the nearest supermarket is?'
soc_meet_laundromat.ai: Alex 扮演洗衣房的邻居，她刚搬来附近不熟悉设备，先是抱怨机器烘干力度不够，等你搭话后会顺势问你这附近有没有好用的干洗店或超市。
soc_meet_laundromat.task: 和她聊聊这台机器的脾气，顺便交换一下附近生活的信息。

tgt: Hi, I need to swap my Thursday 7pm yoga class to the 8pm one—my friend showed up unexpectedly.
I noticed there are 2 spots left in the 8pm class, would that be possible?
It’s the same yoga type, so it won’t mess up my weekly routine.
traps: 错误说法："I want to change my class time" → 搭配不当，swap更准确表时段调换，正确："I need to swap my class time"
错误说法："There is 2 spots left" → 语法错误，名词复数用be动词are，正确："There are 2 spots left"
错误说法："My friend comes sudden" → 语域错误，需用副词短语，正确："My friend showed up unexpectedly"
hob_gym_group_class_swap.ai: Alex是瑜伽团课助教，职责是管理团课名额，诉求是合理协调课程安排
hob_gym_group_class_swap.task: 将周四晚7点的瑜伽课调换到同晚8点的时段

tgt: Everything looks so good, it's hard to choose. What do you usually get?
Do you think the sourdough is worth the wait?
I'm looking for something for a weekend brunch, any suggestions?
traps: 常说 'What do you buy?'，应问 'What do you usually get?'，'get' 在这里更地道。
说 'Is the bread good?' 太宽泛，说 'Is it worth the wait?' 更有针对性。
误用 'recommendation' 名词，直接用 'Do you have any suggestions?' 更自然。
soc_meet_bakery_line.ai: Alex是本地常客，他很清楚什么值得买，对排长队感到很无奈。
soc_meet_bakery_line.task: 询问他的推荐，并借机打开话匣子。

tgt: I had a solid five-card suit backup, so 3 No Trump was a calculated risk.
Let's review our partnership bidding convention agreement after the game.
Trust my hand distribution on this one, we can still make the contract.
traps: 用 'I want to play like this so you follow me' 语气像在命令同伴。应说 'I decided to push for this contract based on my distribution.'
说 'My point is enough' 词汇搭配不对。应说 'My point count meets the minimum threshold.'
直译 'We have big problem' 过于夸张。地道说法是 'Let's see how we can salvage this contract.'
hob_chess_bridge_bidding.ai: Alex 扮演同伴大卫。他是个桥牌老手，对叫牌体系要求严苛，认为你的叫牌打乱了配合。
hob_chess_bridge_bidding.task: 向大卫解释你手牌虽然点数边缘，但牌型有长套支持，这个叫牌是合理的冒险。

tgt: Excuse me, since this train is too full, can I take the next one with this ticket?
Do I need to go to the ticket office to change it?
Is the next train usually less crowded than this one?
traps: 直译腔：说成 "This train is too many people."。表示人多拥挤应该说 "This train is too crowded" 或 "There are too many people"。
动词误用：说成 "change another train"。更换/改签到另一班车应用 "take the next one" 或 "switch to another train"。
句子杂糅：说成 "Can I use this ticket to take next train without fee?"。句子太长啰嗦，直接问 "can I take the next one with this ticket?" 即可。
life_train_overcrowded_next.ai: Alex 扮演耐心温柔的乘务员，会告诉你无座票不限具体班次，你可以直接去等30分钟后的下一班。
life_train_overcrowded_next.task: 向乘务员确认无座票改签下一班车的规则

tgt: Oh, you're right, it does taste a bit intense; I think I might have been too heavy-handed with the sea salt.
I’m still experimenting with this recipe, so thanks for the honest feedback.
Next time, I'll definitely scale back on the seasoning.
traps: 说成 'I added too much salt' 没错，但用 'heavy-handed with the salt' 更具地道的生活气息。
说成 'My cooking is not good' 过于自卑。应说 'I'm still experimenting'，体现出你在享受烹饪过程。
说成 'I will change it next time' 太笼统。地道说法是 'I'll adjust the seasoning' 或 'scale back on the salt'。
hob_cook_salty_soup.ai: Alex是你的邻居，他很礼貌，但因为汤实在太咸，他试图暗示你这汤可能不适合他的口味，或者询问配方。
hob_cook_salty_soup.task: 意识到邻居的暗示，承认自己手抖加多了盐，并提出下次改进。

tgt: Being that close to the stage is a once-in-a-lifetime experience for me.
It's steep, but the atmosphere up front is totally worth the splurge.
I'd rather spend more for a memorable night than sit way in the back.
traps: 把“门票很贵”说成 ticket is expensive，不够生动，地道口语可用 steep 或 pricey。
表达“偶尔奢侈一把”说 use money luxury，应说 treat myself 或 worth the splurge。
把“山顶票（座位很远）”直译为 top seat，应说 back row 或 nosebleed section。
talk_shopop_concert_ticket.ai: Alex 扮演你的旅游搭子。他觉得花大价钱买摇滚区前排性价比太低，视听效果其实差不多。
talk_shopop_concert_ticket.task: 向 Alex 解释近距离看偶像的沉浸感和情感价值是无价的，这笔钱花得很值。

tgt: I'm heading to the supermarket now. Is there anything I can pick up for you to return the favor?
You helped me so much with my package last week, so please let me help you.
It's really no trouble at all.
traps: 说成 'I want to pay you back'，容易引起误解（以为要给钱）。应说 'I want to return the favor'。
说成 'Do you need help?'。应说 'Is there anything I can pick up for you?'。
说成 'It is no problem'。地道说法是 'It's no trouble at all'。
soc_borrow_time.ai: 你的邻居。他觉得你很客气，正巧缺牛奶。
soc_borrow_time.task: 主动提出帮对方买东西以报答之前的帮忙

tgt: My take is that smart home gadgets can sometimes be a bit over-engineered.
You might want to tweak the sensitivity settings to avoid false triggers.
It's a cool concept, but simple solutions often work better day to day.
traps: 说成 'My view is smart home is too much designed.' 错误在于 over-engineered 是形容过度设计的固定搭配，不能拆开用 too much designed。
说成 'You need to change the sensitive level.' 错误在于 sensitive 是形容词，应该用名词 sensitivity，且 tweak 比 change 更符合微调的技术语境。
说成 'It is a good idea, but simple way is better.' 错误在于 concept 比 idea 更地道，day to day 比 everyday 更加自然流畅。
talk_tech_smart_home_neighbor.ai: Alex 扮演邻居大爷，对新买的科技小玩意既着迷又烦恼，随性跟你吐槽误报率太高。
talk_tech_smart_home_neighbor.task: 分享你对智能家居的看法，建议他调节灵敏度，并指出科技产品往往过度设计。

tgt: My toes usually feel a bit cramped after 20 kilometers, so should I size up?
Do you think a half-size larger would cause too much heel slippage?
Could I try them on with my own running socks to check the fit?
traps: 说 'This shoe is small'。应说 'This shoe feels tight' 或者 'The fit is too snug'。
说 'I am size 42'。英语环境用US尺码，应说 'I'm a US size 9'。
说 'I don't like this big size'。应说 'I'm concerned about the extra room in the toe box'。
hob_run_shoe_store_sizing.ai: 店员。经验丰富，认为跑步时脚部会充血肿胀，坚持大半码更科学。
hob_run_shoe_store_sizing.task: 讨论尺码选择，并请对方解释长距离跑对鞋码的要求。

tgt: You can see this integration everywhere in commercial spaces now, especially post-2024.
It's fascinating how quickly digital installations have gone from novelty to mainstream.
The challenge isn't the technology anymore, but keeping the audience engaged.
traps: 使用 'You can see this everywhere now'。语气可以更生动，用 'You see this integration everywhere'。
使用 'It becomes normal'。表达从新鲜事物变成主流用 'from a novelty to mainstream'。
使用 'The problem is not tech'。表达核心挑战转移了用 'The bottleneck isn't the tech itself'。
talk_work_art_gallery.ai: Alex 扮演对艺术和科技交集感兴趣的观众，态度好奇且友好。
talk_work_art_gallery.task: 简要聊聊科技与创意行业结合的趋势，表达你的直观感受

tgt: I'm planning to go for a hike this Saturday to recharge.
It’s a moderate trail with some great scenery.
Would you like to join me for some fresh air?
traps: 说成 'Go for hiking'，地道说法是 'go for a hike' 或 'go hiking'。
说成 'Get energy back'，地道说法是 'to recharge' 或 'to feel refreshed'。
说成 'Is the way hard?'，地道说法是 'Is the trail challenging?'。
talk_health_weekend_hiking.ai: 朋友 Alex，他很感兴趣，想询问徒步的难度和具体时间。
talk_health_weekend_hiking.task: 邀请朋友参加周六的徒步活动，并说明这是一个放松身心的好机会。

tgt: Excuse me, I hate to be a bother, but this steak is actually cold in the middle.
Could you please have the kitchen heat it up for me?
Thank you for taking care of this so quickly.
traps: 常说 'The food is not hot'。不够精准，应说 'The food is cold' 或 'It’s undercooked'。
常说 'Give me a new one'。语气太像命令，用 'Could you please reheat it?' 更礼貌。
常说 'This is bad'。太笼统，应具体说明 'The temperature of the steak is not right'。
life_emo_restaurant_cold_food.ai: Alex是服务生，他会表示歉意并愿意立即帮你拿回厨房重新处理。
life_emo_restaurant_cold_food.task: 礼貌但坚定地指出问题并要求重新加热。

tgt: I totally get that your supply costs are higher, but thirty percent is a huge jump for families.
People want to support local farms, but their grocery budgets are already stretched thin.
It's a tough spot for both the vendors and the shoppers.
traps: 错用 'your cost is high'。地道表达是 'your supply costs are higher' 或 'overhead is going up'。
误用 'family's money'。地道表达是 'grocery budgets are already stretched thin'。
直译 'this is difficult for everyone'。地道说法是 'It's a tough spot for both sides' 或 'tough on both vendors and shoppers'。
talk_news_farmers_market.ai: Alex 扮演摊主玛丽。她解释自己不是故意抬价，而是农场进货价就在涨。她会问你是否觉得现在买普通超市的菜更划算。
talk_news_farmers_market.task: 在理解摊主成本压力的同时，表达高昂价格对日常家庭开支的影响。

tgt: Is it possible to exchange this for a different size?
Does the policy allow me to swap it for a different color instead?
How long does the whole exchange process usually take?
traps: 说成 'I want to change this' 意图模糊，应改为 'I would like to exchange this for a different size.'
说成 'Can I get money back?' 不够专业，应改为 'Is a refund available for this item?'
说成 'How long?' 太简略，应改为 'How long do I have to return this item?'
talk_ask_store_return.ai: 你是店员，表示可以退换，但需要出示收据，且限7天内。
talk_ask_store_return.task: 通过追问，确认是否可以换不同颜色，以及流程大概多久。

tgt: Trust me, my clue only connects to those two specific cards on the board.
I didn't mean the phone logo at all, just the fruit cards.
Let's check the rulebook on giving ambiguous clues if you aren't sure.
traps: 使用 'My clue only links to'，虽然意思能懂，但在桌游里表达『关联到』用 'connect to' 或 'refer to' 比 'link to' 更地道。
use 'I don't mean the phone'，在解释过去说的话时应用过去时 'I didn't mean'。
使用 'Look at the rule book'，加上动词 'check' 或 'consult' 会比单纯的 'look at' 更有桌游玩家的风范。
hob_chess_codenames_clue.ai: 马克，蓝队的队长。他抱着胳膊笑着指出这个提示词涵盖的范围有点模糊，大家一起来评判一下。
hob_chess_codenames_clue.task: 向马克解释你这个提示词只对应桌面上那两个特定的卡片，没有违规

tgt: I'm so sorry, I totally thought this was mine because we have the exact same hoodie.
Let me check the pockets just to make sure I didn't mix anything up.
My bad, I should have checked the tag before taking it out of the dryer.
traps: 说成 'I take your clothes by mistake.'。错在动词时态不对，拿错东西已经发生，必须用过去式 took。
说成 'It is my fault to make this mistake.'。虽然能懂，但地道表达应该用动名词主语 'Making this mistake is my fault' 或更直接的 'I'm entirely to blame.'。
说成 'I am sorry for my wrong action.'。'wrong action' 听起来像外交辞令或法律审判，生活对话中直接说 'I'm really sorry for the mix-up' 即可。
soc_name_laundry_room.ai: Alex 扮演洗衣房里的邻居，他刚洗完衣服来收。他发现你拿了他的衣服，语气平和地跟你核对。
soc_name_laundry_room.task: 向对方解释自己因为衣服太像而认错并拿错，真诚道歉并归还。

tgt: What's your strategy for beating this boss?
I've been stuck on this part for hours, any tips?
Do you have any recommendations for a better build to beat him?
traps: 不要说 'How to kill him?'，太生硬。地道说法是 'How do I beat him?'。
不要说 'I have no way to pass.'，中式思维直译。地道说法是 'I'm stuck on this level.'。
不要说 'What is your skill?'，这通常指个人技术。问游戏建议应该说 'What are your tips?'。
talk_game_rpg_advice.ai: Alex 是资深玩家，他很乐意分享自己的配装心得和打法技巧。
talk_game_rpg_advice.task: 请教对方关于 Boss 的通关策略。

tgt: Excuse me, could you reach that box of coffee for me?
I'm afraid I can't quite reach it.
Thanks a lot for your help!
traps: 错用“Get that for me”：祈使句在职场或公共场合显得没礼貌。加“Could you...”是必须的。
错用“I am too short”：略带自嘲，但不如“I can't quite reach it”客观描述事实自然。
错用“Give me that”：过于随便，容易引起误解。使用“Could you reach that...”更清晰。
soc_favor_grocery_shelf.ai: 你是店员，微笑着放下手中的东西，帮你拿下了咖啡。
soc_favor_grocery_shelf.task: 委婉请求店员协助取物

tgt: Mia, time is running out! You have fifteen minutes before the school bus arrives at the corner.
Please swallow that bite of bread, grab your toothbrush, and head straight to the bathroom.
If we miss the bus this morning, I will have to drive you, and you know that means traffic will make me late for my meeting.
traps: “时间快来不及了”地道表达是 time is running out，不要直译成 time is coming to end。
“直奔浴室”用 head straight to the bathroom 比 walk to bathroom 更有催促和方向感。
“这会让我开会迟到”用 make me late for my meeting，注意介词用 for 而不是 to。
soc_parent_brush_teeth.ai: Alex 扮演女儿 Mia，因为没睡醒动作慢吞吞，嘴里塞着面包，慢条斯理地跟玩具猫说话。
soc_parent_brush_teeth.task: 催促女儿抓紧时间去刷牙洗脸，避免赶不上校车

tgt: I noticed you're learning German, that's impressive!
Actually, I'm trying to brush up on my own language learning. I'm learning German, but my native language is Chinese.
Since we take the same train, would you be interested in a language exchange?
traps: 说 'My mother tongue is Chinese' 有点过于严肃。在日常社交中用 'I'm a native Chinese speaker' 或 'My first language is Chinese' 更自然。
说 'Do you have interest to talk?' 是中式思维。应说 'Are you interested in chatting?'。
说 'We can practice in the train' 介词错误。应说 'We can practice on the train'。
hob_lang_train_commute.ai: Alex 是位园艺设计师，她曾去过中国旅游，对中文很有好感，想重拾基础。
hob_lang_train_commute.task: 说明你是在自学，并询问她是否想一起在通勤路上互相练练对话。

tgt: A tour priced at only 699 yuan definitely means they will force you to buy things at souvenir shops all day.
It won't be a relaxing vacation; you'll spend most of your time sitting on a bus and being pressured to shop.
Cancel this group tour, and let me book a proper high-speed train and a nice hotel for your trip instead.
traps: 直译 'cheap group' 不够地道。指低价购物团常称为 'budget shopping tour' 或 'forced-shopping tour'。
说旅游很累用 'very tired' 过于单薄。表达舟车劳顿应用 'exhausting and packed with endless shopping stops'。
劝人取消行程用 'don't go' 太生硬。委婉劝阻应用 'It might be better to skip this particular tour'。
soc_elder_travel_plan.ai: Alex 扮演你的母亲。她觉得这是老姐妹推荐的绝对靠谱，认为你是在泼冷水、嫌她花钱，坚持要去。
soc_elder_travel_plan.task: 向母亲解释低价团的购物陷阱，说服她取消行程，改由你来帮她定制真正的自由行。

tgt: I appreciate your advice, but I prefer to handle things my way.
We usually do things a bit differently in our household.
Let's just relax and enjoy your visit without worrying about these small details.
traps: 使用 'Stop nagging me' 带有强烈的指责和叛逆语气，对长辈很不礼貌，应当用 'I appreciate your advice, but...' 来缓冲。
使用 'You don't need to control my life' 属于夸大其词的指控，容易激化矛盾。
使用 'This is my house so listen to me' 显得盛气凌人，正确的边界感表达应强调 'handle things my way' 而非争夺主导权。
soc_bound_parent_overstay.ai: Alex 是来家里做客的长辈，他觉得自己的生活经验丰富，是出于好意才对你提出各种建议和提醒。
soc_bound_parent_overstay.task: 委婉但清楚地请对方不用事事干涉，给彼此留出空间

tgt: Leo, I'm moving to a new house tomorrow, so I have a little gift for you.
Here is a box of building blocks, I hope you like playing with them.
Be a good boy and take care!
traps: 说成 'give you a toy' 稍微生硬，说 'have a little gift for you' 或 'have something for you' 更温暖。
说 'I hope you like to play' 语法不对，接动名词应为 'hope you like playing with them'。
说 'Be a good child' 有点像老师训话，对邻居小孩说 'Be a good boy' 或 'Take care, buddy' 更自然。
soc_farewell_neighbor_kid.ai: Leo 非常高兴地接过积木，跑去喊他妈妈出来，母子俩一起对你的离开表示不舍和感谢。
soc_farewell_neighbor_kid.task: 把积木送给邻居小孩 Leo 并向他道别

tgt: It's just a 20-minute drive from the city center.
The monthly rent is 1800 pounds, which is quite reasonable.
I love the light gray sofa in the living room; it feels very cozy.
traps: 说成 'It is 20 minutes far from the center'。直接用 'It is 20 minutes away' 或 'a 20-minute drive'。
说成 'The rent is 1800 pounds per month'。虽然对，但 'monthly rent' 更加书面且简洁。
说成 'It feels very comfort'。应使用形容词 'cozy' 或 'comfortable'，'comfort' 是名词。
soc_family_new_apartment.ai: 你的配偶，关心居住环境和租金是否合理，想看房子的细节。
soc_family_new_apartment.task: 介绍公寓的地理位置和客厅的装修风格。

tgt: Is there an updated rate card I could take a look at?
I was surprised by the fare increase compared to my last trip here.
Does the current fare include all the surcharges?
traps: 不要说 'You cheated me'，这是指控欺诈。应说 'The fare seems a bit higher than I anticipated'。
不要说 'Why you charge so much?'，语法错误且语气重。应说 'Could you clarify why the fare has increased?'。
不要说 'I know the price'，听起来很傲慢。用 'I was under the impression that the rate was lower'。
talk_money_taxi_fare.ai: 出租车司机，他坚称这是公司统一调价，且油费成本确实是他个人无法承受的负担。
talk_money_taxi_fare.task: 礼貌确认涨价的合理性，并询问是否有固定费率清单以核实费用。

tgt: Dubbing totally ruins the actors' real emotional delivery.
You lose all the nuance of the original performance if you don't hear their actual voices.
I'd rather read subtitles than listen to cringey voice acting.
traps: 说成 'Dubbing destroys actors' true feeling.'。feeling 泛指感觉，表达演员的情感传递用 emotional delivery 或 performance 更地道。
说成 'You will miss the detail.'。detail 通常用复数，且细节的微妙之处用 nuance 显得更地道。
说成 'I prefer to read subtitles than listening.'。固定句型混淆，prefer doing to doing 或 would rather do than do，地道说法是 'I'd rather read subtitles than listen to...'。
talk_movie_subtitles_debate.ai: Alex，你的外国朋友。他认为看字幕太累、会分散注意力，试图说服大家都选配音版，并认为配音演员其实配得很专业。
talk_movie_subtitles_debate.task: 坚决反对看配音版，陈述原声配音和演员原声演技对电影质感的重要性

tgt: How much is the hourly rate for a standard pool table right now?
Can we rent the carbon fiber cues instead of using the house cues?
Is there an extra charge for renting the upgraded cues?
traps: 询问台费时中式英语：不宜说 'How much money for one hour table?'，地道说法应用 'How much is the hourly rate for a pool table?'。
称呼公杆时词汇不对：不宜说 'public sticks'，地道说法应用 'house cues'。
询问额外费用时搭配错误：不宜说 'Do I need to pay more money for this?'，地道说法应用 'Is there an extra charge for renting these?'。
talk_game_billiards_rent.ai: Alex 是俱乐名前台，他会为你安排一张空闲的 3 号球桌，并向你介绍普通公杆和高级碳纤维球杆的不同租赁价格。
talk_game_billiards_rent.task: 确认台费按小时怎么计费，以及高级球杆的租赁需要额外加多少钱

tgt: I’m so sorry for the misunderstanding, I actually ordered a special gift for your 30th.
It’s arriving tomorrow due to a courier delay, but I wanted to make sure you knew how much I care.
Happy milestone birthday! I really hope you’ll love the vase once it arrives.
traps: 说成'I give you a gift'，时态错误，既然没送到，应用现在完成时'I have ordered a gift'。
说成'My gift is very expensive'，虽然没错但语域不对，商务之外谈礼物不宜强调价格，应说'a thoughtful gift'。
说成'You misunderstand me'，语气过于生硬指责，应改用更柔和的'I think there might be a misunderstanding'。
soc_congrats_birthday_gift_dispute.ai: 邻居。他觉得你不够重视这次派对，表现得有些刻薄和委屈，但他其实很想听到你的解释。
soc_congrats_birthday_gift_dispute.task: 化解尴尬，证明你准备了精美的礼物，并表达你的歉意和真诚的祝福。

tgt: Wait, the scale showed 1.5 kilos at 4 dollars a kilo, right?
That should be around 13 dollars, but you charged me 18.
Could you double-check the total for these tomatoes?
traps: 说成 'You calculate wrong.'，语法错误，地道说法是 'You charged me too much based on the weight.'
说成 'The price is not match.'，缺少动词，地道说法是 'The total doesn't match the weight on the scale.'
说成 'Look at the calculator.'，计算器应为 'scale'（秤），用错词会引起误会。
life_food_farmers_market_overweight.ai: Alex 扮演摊主。他会笑着说可能按大个头有机品种算错了，需要你跟他重新看一眼电子秤上的单价。
life_food_farmers_market_overweight.task: 指出摊主计算的总价与单重不符，要求按实际重量重新计算

tgt: Hi, my home internet for apartment 802 just went down.
The Wi-Fi router lights are flashing red and I have no connection.
Could you check if there is an outage in my area?
traps: 说成 'My internet is broken'。网络中断不用 broken，地道说法是 'went down' 或 'is not working'。
说成 'I have no internet signal'。家用宽带一般不说 signal，连不上网直接说 'I have no connection' 或 'I can't connect to the internet'。
问有没有大面积断网说成 'Is there a net stop in my place?' 属于严重中式直译，全区断网的标准说法是 'an outage in my area'。
life_neigh_internet_down.ai: Alex 扮演宽带客服人员，语气专业，会引导你核对账户信息并尝试重启路由器。
life_neigh_internet_down.task: 向客服报告网络中断并寻求技术支持

tgt: Even hawker food is feeling the pinch of inflation these days.
Has the stall rental gone up much for you guys this year?
It's a pity because hawker centers are supposed to be the affordable option.
traps: use "Hawker food is also rising price"，food 不能自己发动作动词，应用 hawker food is getting more expensive 或 feeling the pinch。
use "Rent fee"，租金直接用 rent 或 rental 即可，不需要加 fee。
use "Supposed to be cheap"，cheap 贬义色彩较重，平价、实惠用 affordable option 更恰当。
talk_money_singapore_hawker.ai: Alex 扮演档主，语气亲切地用Singlish腔调跟你解释说水电杂费和鸡肉、米饭的进货成本都在往上走，薄利多销也快顶不住了。
talk_money_singapore_hawker.task: 向档主了解平民熟食中心的物价上涨情况与经营压力

tgt: I really appreciate the pointers you've given me today, Mark, but I'm not looking for personal training at the moment.
To be honest, I'm sticking to a strict budget for now and can't commit to extra sessions.
I'm quite happy with my current routine for the time being, but thanks for the offer.
traps: 说成'Your price is too high'很冒犯；应说'It’s a bit out of my budget right now'.
说成'I don't want it'听起来像拒绝沟通；应说'I’m not in the market for personal training'.
说成'You are annoying'会引发冲突；应说'I appreciate the offer, but I prefer training on my own'.
soc_decline_gym_coaching.ai: Mark，健身房的私人教练，专业且执着，认为你的动作需要纠正，推销课程是为了你好。
soc_decline_gym_coaching.task: 坚定拒绝购买课程，但要承认对方的指导确实有帮助，以维持良好的锻炼氛围。

tgt: I'm all set, thank you. I just want to relax on my own.
I'm not interested in any spa services, thanks for asking.
Please, I really just need some peace and quiet before my flight.
traps: 说'I'm busy'，对方会说按摩正好帮你休息，应直接说'I'm not interested in any spa services'。
说'It's too expensive'，这会让对方跟你谈优惠，拒绝推销应强调立场，即'I'm all set'。
说'Stop pushing me'，语气太强，应说'I really just need some peace and quiet'。
life_no_airport_lounge.ai: Alex是休息室聘请的理疗师，他想通过提成增加收入，认为你需要放松，并试图在你不回应时再次强调优惠。
life_no_airport_lounge.task: 明确表示你只需要休息，不需要任何按摩服务。

tgt: That's very kind of you to offer, but I'm actually just taking some solo photos today.
I'm sorry, I'm not really looking to include anyone else in my personal travel diary.
I appreciate the offer, but maybe we could just take separate photos instead?
traps: 错误说“No, go away”太粗鲁。应说“I appreciate the offer, but...”表示感谢后拒绝。
错误说“I don't like you”会导致冲突。应说“I am just taking solo photos”给出合理理由。
错误说“Don't come into my camera”带有攻击性。应说“I'd prefer to take this one alone”表达个人偏好。
life_tour_group_photo_refusal.ai: Alex是其中一个游客，非常热情，觉得一起合影是件好事，不理解为什么你要拒绝。
life_tour_group_photo_refusal.task: 礼貌地拒绝，同时不破坏旅游心情

tgt: The weather is getting quite chilly this week.
How about we go for some spicy hot pot this Thursday at 7 PM?
It would be a great way to warm up.
traps: 用了 'The weather becomes cold'。天气变冷地道表达是 'The weather is getting chilly'。
用了 'eat hot pot'。去吃火锅常用 'go for hot pot' 或 'have hot pot' 连用。
用了 'make me warm'。暖和起来的标准表达是 'warm up'，而不是 make me warm。
soc_invite_hot_pot.ai: Alex 扮演 Chloe，她一听是火锅立刻食欲大动，开心地答应了周四晚上的饭局。
soc_invite_hot_pot.task: 成功约到 Chloe 本周四晚上 7 点去吃火锅。

tgt: The rug I received is totally different from the picture online.
