tgt: I wanted to inform you that I’ll be stepping down as CFO of our company on January 20 FY27 to take on a new role as CFO at an autonomous vehicle startup.
We’re currently in the middle of our annual financial compliance audit, and I want to ensure we finalize all the outstanding documentation before my departure.
I can introduce you to my interim replacement once they join the team to ensure a smooth transition for the audit process.
traps: 使用"I will help you finish the audit"这种过于绝对的表达，地道的说法应为"My team can support your interim team with the audit documentation and regulatory filings"，前者显得过度承诺且不符合专业服务的边界。
直译"年度审计"为"year audit"是中式英语，地道的表达应为"annual audit"或"fiscal year-end audit"。
使用"You must finish the audit before I leave"这种强硬语气，应使用"To ensure a seamless handover, could we aim to complete the core audit procedures by mid-January next year?"来体现合作态度。
wk_exit_client_cfo_us.ai: Alex扮演约翰·史密斯，他是客户方的CFO，现在正式告知你离职计划，希望确认后续的审计对接人，同时希望你团队能协助他完成年度审计的收尾工作。
wk_exit_client_cfo_us.task: 确认年度审计的收尾时间节点，敲定后续的客户对接人，同时承诺协助客户完成审计收尾

tgt: Officer, I sincerely apologize. I was keeping an eye on the clock for my flight at SFO.
My flight departs in less than an hour and a half, and I lost track of my speed.
I completely understand the safety risk, and I will cooperate fully to expedite this.
traps: 使用 "I am very urgent" 表达自己很着急。这是典型中式英语，"urgent" 常用作形容词修饰事情紧急，形容人很急地道说法是 "I'm in a rush" 或 "I'm pressed for time"。
直译 "Please give me a chance" 请求宽恕。这在严肃的执法现场显得过于幼稚和戏剧化，地道说法是 "I'd appreciate any leniency you could offer" 或者是 "Is there any way we could speed this up?"。
冒失地问 "How much should I pay you?"。在国外这极易被误认为是现场行贿犯罪，地道询问罚款流程的写法是 "How can I resolve this ticket?" 或 "Can I pay this fine online?"。
talk_car_speeding_trooper.ai: Alex 扮演加州公路巡警（State Trooper）。他态度冷峻、公事公办，要求你出示驾照和租车合同，并询问你为什么开得这么快。
talk_car_speeding_trooper.task: 向州警合理解释超速原因，争取让他快速开出罚单放行，或者口头警告后让你走，以免耽误航班。

tgt: It offers a rare, first-person perspective on structural healthcare failure.
Unlike typical memoirs, this book integrates neuroscientific research with personal history.
I'd really appreciate it if you could hold a copy for me from the next shipment.
traps: 想表达'请帮我预订一本'时说 'Can you order a book for me please?' 过于随意且缺乏针对性。地道预订表达应为 'Could you put me down for a copy from the next arrival?'
用 'This book is different with other books' 属于固定搭配错误。'different' 习惯与 'from' 搭配，地道说法是 'This book differs significantly from standard memoirs'.
表达'这本书很有深度'时使用 'This book has deep meaning'，听起来过于幼拙。地道表达为 'It offers profound insights into...'.
talk_book_trauma_memoir.ai: 急着下班的书店店员。他耐性有限，认为这本书只是噱头，要求你用两句话说清楚这本书为什么值得书店为你打破流程特批预订。
talk_book_trauma_memoir.task: 在店员关门打烊前，清晰表达该书对创伤机制的独特视角，促使其同意为你填写预订单。

tgt: I'm not escaping; I'm just recalibrating my inner compass.
The silence between the notes is what I'm actually here for.
In a city this crowded, you have to build your own walls to stay sane.
traps: 错误使用 "I don't like people"（我不喜欢人），这会显得愤世嫉俗。地道说法是 "I'm a bit socially overstimulated"（我的社交感官过载了）。
直译 "Tokyo is too many people"，语法不当。地道说法是 "The sheer density of Tokyo can be quite overwhelming"（东京的人口密度令人窒息）。
回答 "The music is good"，太苍白。地道表达为 "The performance is incredibly immersive"（演出非常有沉浸感）。
soc_deep_tokyo_jazz.ai: Alex 是个中年建筑师，经常来这里。他觉得你身上有一种“出世”的气质，想知道你在这个拥挤的东京街头，内心在寻求什么样的安静。
soc_deep_tokyo_jazz.task: 与 Alex 探讨“逃避”与“充电”的区别，分享你在繁华都市中保持自我独立的策略。

tgt: I really want to support your dream, but relying on a single income makes our financial margin very tight.
Our fixed monthly expenses are $4,200, which leaves almost zero room for unexpected costs.
Could you consider writing part-time first, or saving up another three months of expenses before quitting?
traps: 语气过于打击打击对方写成 'Your dream is unrealistic'（不合时宜，应从财务风险切入 'relying on a single income makes things very tight'）。
把“应急空间”直译为 'no room for surprise'（地道表达应为 'leave zero room for unexpected costs/emergencies'）。
直译“延迟辞职”为 'delay your resigning'（口语中更习惯用 'delay quitting' 或 'push back your resignation date'）。
soc_partner_career_gap.ai: 扮演你的伴侣 Alex。追求文学梦想已久，准备了 $5,000 个人积蓄作为补充，渴望得到你的支持，但也愿意理性评估财务风险。
soc_partner_career_gap.task: 肯定对方追求梦想的勇气，但用具体数据说明单收入来源的抗风险能力较差，建议对方考虑兼职写作或延后半年辞职。

tgt: Given the impossibility of obtaining external confirmation, I propose we perform alternative procedures including examining shipping documents and bank settlements.
I have assessed the risks, and the combination of inspection and analytical procedures should provide sufficient evidence.
Could you review my plan for alternative procedures to ensure it meets our audit rigor?
traps: 使用 'I think it is fine'，太主观，应使用 'Based on my assessment, this provides a reasonable level of assurance'。
使用 'There is no other way'，应使用 'As obtaining external confirmation is currently unfeasible, we have developed a robust alternative approach'。
使用 'The plan is perfect'，应使用 'I would appreciate your feedback on whether this alternative approach aligns with our audit methodology'。
aud_conf_alternative_procedure.ai: 合伙人。他比较严谨，正在质疑如果替代程序的效果不如函证，如何保证这一块的审计证据充分性。
aud_conf_alternative_procedure.task: 向合伙人证明你已制定的替代审计程序足够周密，能弥补函证缺失带来的证据真空。

tgt: I'm actually a bit allergic to dogs, could we keep him in the other room?
He's so energetic! But do you mind if I keep my distance?
I love dogs, but my allergies are acting up a bit. Could you help me with that?
traps: 说成 'Your dog is dirty.'，这会冒犯主人，应该关注自己的身体反应，比如 'I'm having an allergic reaction'。
说成 'Please take your dog away.'，语气太生硬像下命令，应该加点礼貌用词，如 'Do you mind...?'。
说成 'I am allergic dog.'，这是语法错误，应说 'I am allergic to dogs'。
soc_guest_dog_allergy.ai: Sarah，很爱她的狗，认为狗狗只是在表达欢迎。她会试图安抚狗，但你可以委婉地请她帮忙让狗离你远一点。
soc_guest_dog_allergy.task: 礼貌地请求对方把狗带开，同时不伤害朋友的感情

tgt: I've been waking up in the middle of the night lately. Does magnesium really help?
When is the best time of day to take this supplement?
Are there any side effects if I take it every night?
traps: 说成 "I always wake up at night and cannot sleep well"。表达略显啰嗦，地道说法是 "I've been waking up in the middle of the night lately"。
说成 "What time is best to eat this?"。保健品通常用 "take" 而不是 "eat"，应说 "When is the best time of day to take this supplement?"。
说成 "Will it make me bad?"。表达过于幼稚模糊，询问副作用应用 "Are there any side effects?"。
talk_health_sleep_supplement.ai: Alex 扮演药剂师，他详细询问了你的睡眠状况，建议你在睡前一小时服用，并提醒不要空腹过量。
talk_health_sleep_supplement.task: 向药剂师说明自己的睡眠困扰，并弄清楚镁剂的最佳服用方法。

tgt: LPL teams are known for their aggressive and chaotic team-fighting style.
That Baron steal in the first game completely swung the momentum.
It's going to be a close series, probably going all the way to game five.
traps: 不要说 They kill monsters well，要用专业的 To secure objectives 或 Baron steal。
不要说 He plays the game very careful，形容意识好用地道的 His map awareness is insane。
不要说 I think they will win 3-0，形容横扫要用 I'm predicting a 3-0 sweep。
talk_sport_lolesports_finals.ai: Alex 是旁边的观众，他支持 LCK 战队，认为他们的中单选手的补刀和意识是世界第一，LPL 很难赢。
talk_sport_lolesports_finals.task: 支持 LPL 战队。你需要提到 LPL 战队在团战（team-fighting）中的侵略性，以及刚才第一局中打野选手的抢大龙操作。

tgt: I understand there are restrictions on lithium batteries; can we switch to ground shipping?
Does FedEx provide specific UN3481 labels for laptops with built-in batteries?
I'd like to purchase additional insurance for this shipment, as it's valued at $1,500.
traps: 询问价格时说 "How much money for this?"，太随意。地道说法是 "What's the shipping quote for ground service?"。
直译 "The battery is inside, cannot take out"。应说 "The battery is integrated into the device"。
说 "I want to buy a safe" 来表示保价。应使用 "I want to declare the value for insurance purposes"。
life_post_sf_lithium.ai: 柜台职员Mike。他很注重安全规定，觉得处理含电池电子产品很麻烦。如果你不能证明包装合规或者同意改用慢速陆运，他不会受理。
life_post_sf_lithium.task: 与Mike协商，确认哪种包装或运输方式（如陆运 Ground Shipping）可以寄送含电池设备，并确保包裹有保价。

tgt: Hey mate, love the spirit, but that flag is completely blocking the screen for everyone behind you.
Could you lower it down a bit during the actual penalty shootout?
We all want to cheer for the team, but we can't see a single play right now.
traps: 用 'Put down your cloth' 指代国旗。把国旗 'flag' 说成 'cloth' 极不地道甚至失礼，且命令句型 'Put down' 显得粗暴。
用 'You block me' 表达挡住视线。英语中表达挡视线常用 'block my view' 或 'block the screen'，不能简单说 'block me'。
用 'Have some public ethic' 批评对方公德心。直译中文‘讲点公德’在英语口语中极其怪异，应改用 'Please be mindful of the people sitting behind you'。
talk_sport_public_viewing_flag_block.ai: Alex 是这位挥旗的狂热球迷，沉浸在激动情绪中，觉得在 Fan Zone 挥旗理所当然，对后方的抱怨有些不以为然。
talk_sport_public_viewing_flag_block.task: 沟通协调挥旗的时间或角度，既尊重对方的狂热情绪，又确保自己和身后人群能看到比赛。

tgt: Do you think a full professional overhaul is necessary for this F2, or should I just stick to a minor cleaning?
I’m documenting the vintage photography experience for my blog—do you happen to know a reliable film lab in the city?
Is it common for models from this era to have these tiny specks in the viewfinder?
traps: 不要说 'Do a full cleaning'，这听起来像清洁工。地道说法是 'professional overhaul' 或 'servicing'。
不要说 'Is this normal for 1975 year's model'，语法错误。应说 'Is this common for a 1975 model'。
不要说 'I want to write a blog about it'，太生硬。应说 'I’m documenting my experience for my blog'。
hob_write_vintage_camera.ai: Alex 是店主，他很懂相机，认为那是自然老化的痕迹，不建议大拆，但他可以推荐一种特定的清洁剂。
hob_write_vintage_camera.task: 向店主确认这台相机是否需要专业的深度拆解清理，并询问他是否有推荐的胶片冲洗店以供你的博客评测参考。

tgt: Can we split the shipment — send the laptop today and leave the power banks out?
If lithium batteries can't fly, is there a ground or sea option you can book for me?
Since the box is a lot lighter now, can it be re-rated and the difference refunded?
traps: 把「充电宝」直译成 "charge treasure" 或 "mobile power"，店员听不懂。英语固定说 "power bank" 或 "portable charger"，电池本身叫 "lithium batteries"。
"I already paid 96 dollars, so you must send it." 里的 "must" 是对店员下命令，语气过硬。改成 "I've already paid $96 — what happens to that if the box gets lighter?"，把矛头指向费用而不是人。
把「那怎么办」直译成 "Then how to do?"，这不成句。自然说法是 "So what are my options?" 或 "What can we do from here?"
life_post_powerbank.ai: Alex 扮演 DHL 门店店员。他先照常收件、看到电池才解释规定，愿意帮你想别的办法（拆出来分寄、改地面/海运、重新称重），态度平常；但危险品这条他松不了口。
life_post_powerbank.task: 让笔记本那部分今天照常寄出并拿到运单号，充电宝要么找到合规寄法、要么当场取出退还，同时把已付的 96 美元按新重量重新计费。

tgt: We can flag that it's expected to be settled at completion, but it still needs to sit in the debt-like column today.
The list is our view; the pricing conversation is for you and the buyer.
If you can give me the settlement plan in writing, I'll footnote it right next to the number.
traps: 说 "It must be included in the net debt."——must 加被动句既生硬又显得没人担责。改说 "We'd need to keep it in net debt" 或 "it belongs in net debt on our read."
说 "This is only my personal opinion."——想谦虚，结果把结论说没了。要说 "That's our view based on what we've seen" 或 "That's the position in the draft."
说 "I agree with you in principle, but..."——中文「原则上同意」常常是不同意，英语的 in principle 表示实质同意、只剩细节，对方会当你已让步。只是理解对方就说 "I see where you're coming from, but…"
dd_rep_debt_like_items.ai: Alex 扮演卖方CFO。他认为股东借款交割前一定会清掉，所以不该进 net debt。他先摆自己的商业逻辑，也愿意听你的口径是怎么来的。
dd_rep_debt_like_items.task: 守住 debt-like 的归类，同时把「定价谈判归买卖双方、口径归你」这条界线用英文讲清楚。

tgt: Are you around Thursday evening? I was thinking half seven at the gym.
We could keep it to two hours so you're out in time for the birthday thing.
If Thursdays generally work for you, we could just make it a regular thing.
traps: 别说 “Do you have time on Thursday?” —— 这句在英语里听着像你要找人办事、有事相求。约人玩用 “Are you free Thursday?” 或 “Are you around Thursday evening?”
别说 “Can you accompany me to climb?” —— accompany 是书面语，且带「陪我」的味道，像求人帮忙。要说 “Do you want to climb together Thursday?” 或 “Fancy a session Thursday?”
说日子别只说 “next Thursday” —— 英语母语者对它是「这周四」还是「下周四」也常有分歧。加个日期最稳：“this Thursday, the 19th.”
life_invite_climb_thu.ai: Alex 演这位攀岩搭子，友善但周四本来有别的安排（八点半有个朋友的生日局）。他会认真跟你讨论时间够不够、要不要改成周三；也会好奇你是想约这一次还是想固定下来，一直追问细节，需要你说清楚。
life_invite_climb_thu.task: 发出明确的邀请（时间、地点、爬多久、爬完干嘛），接住他关于时间冲突的追问，谈成一个双方都能到的方案，并试探能不能变成每周固定。

tgt: The garden's great — my worry is that everything I actually do is in town.
Could we rent out there for six months before we buy anything?
If we do move, I'd want us to agree now that I keep two nights a week in the city.
traps: 别说 'live in suburb'：要么 'in the suburbs'（固定用复数带 the），要么 'out of town'。单数无冠词的 suburb 母语者不这么说。
别用一句 'I don't like it.' 去回应一个大决定：太单薄，对方只会当成你在闹情绪。说 'It's not the house — it's what I'd be giving up.' 把反对落到具体东西上。
别把「四十分钟车程」说成 'forty minutes by car far away'：语序和搭配都不对。说 'It's a forty-minute drive' 或 'It's forty minutes out.'
soc_partner_move_suburb.ai: Alex 扮演伴侣 Jamie。Jamie 算过账，觉得多一个房间加一个院子太划算，已经很兴奋；愿意听你的顾虑，只要你说得具体，不是一句「我就是不想搬」。
soc_partner_move_suburb.task: 把你真正在乎的东西讲清楚，并谈成一个能检验的条件（先租半年，或者定下每周固定在城里过两晚）。

tgt: Using the Rule of 72, I'd estimate the implied annual return is roughly 25%.
The $1,000 would need to grow by about 25% per year for 10 years to reach $10,000.
Since the stock market historically returns around 8% to 10%, a consistent 25% return is unrealistic, so I'd take the $10,000 in 10 years.
traps: 'The money need to grow 25% every year.' money 是不可数名词，谓语应用单数 needs；且口语中 'would need to' 比 'need to' 更自然。地道说法：'The money would need to grow by 25% per year.'

'By using 72 rule, we can calculate the return is around 25%.' 72 rule 前面缺少定冠词，应为 'the Rule of 72'；calculate 过于正式，口语中常用 estimate 或 figure out。地道说法：'Using the Rule of 72, I'd estimate the return at roughly 25%.'

'It's very difficult to achieve 25% annual return in stock market.' in stock market 缺少定冠词，应为 'in the stock market'；且 'very difficult' 语气稍强，口语中更常用 tough 或 unrealistic。地道说法：'It's tough to generate a 25% annual return in the stock market.'
itv_1000_today_vs_10000_10yr.ai: 你演VP面试官，熟悉DCF和估值模型，会顺着你的心算框架和对比基准追问，检验你是否能清晰解释每一步逻辑。
itv_1000_today_vs_10000_10yr.task: 用英文清晰拆解这道题：先用72法则快速估算隐含CAGR，再与股票市场基准回报对比，给出有依据的结论。

tgt: I bought this 200g saffron pack earlier, but it's actually turmeric powder instead.
I paid 250 liras for this, could you swap it for the correct saffron or give me a full refund?
Sorry to trouble you, but there seems to be a mistake with the spice I purchased.
traps: 说"You sold me fake saffron"，容易引发争执，应该先说自己原本想要的商品和收到的商品
直接把商品扔在柜台，没有礼貌，应该先和店主说明情况再提诉求
忘记说明购买的重量和花费的金额，地道表达需要补充这些具体细节
talk_complain_istanbul_bazaar_shop.ai: Alex扮演香料店店主，会带着疑惑过来查看商品，愿意协助解决问题。
talk_complain_istanbul_bazaar_shop.task: 说明买错商品的情况，要求更换成藏红花或者全额退款

tgt: Sorry about that, I didn’t realize I was being loud.
I’ll turn my volume down right away.
Hope I didn’t interrupt your work too much.
traps: 说"It’s just a game"会显得不尊重别人，会加剧矛盾，应该直接道歉并表示会注意音量。
把"headphones"说成"earphones"虽然也可以，但在高铁这种公共场合，headphones是更常用的说法。
直接反驳"I didn’t make any noise"，会显得固执，应该承认自己的失误并道歉。
talk_sport_train_basketball.ai: Alex是坐在你前排的法国乘客，他正在用笔记本电脑处理工作，他会礼貌地提醒你声音有点大。
talk_sport_train_basketball.task: 礼貌道歉，调低耳机音量，继续安静看比赛。

tgt: My first name and last name seem to have been reversed on the ticket.
Is it possible to correct it in the system and print my boarding pass?
Here is my passport to verify my identity.
traps: 用词不准：把姓和名混淆说成 "My name is wrong"。这会让地勤以为是拼写错误（如把 Zhang 写成 Chang），地勤可能会要求退票重买。应该指明 "first name and last name are reversed" 或 "swapped"。
直译腔："Can you change my name?" 语气听起来像你要改名换姓。地勤没有权限随意修改旅客姓名，应该说 "Could you help me correct the order in the system?"。
语气生硬："You must fix this for me." 带有强烈的命令语气，容易引起地勤抵触。应使用委婉语气："I would appreciate it if you could help me look it up."
life_air_name_reversed.ai: 柜台地勤，态度温和但需要按规章办事，他会要求确认你的护照拼写，并尝试在系统中帮你手动关联或更正。
life_air_name_reversed.task: 向地勤解释名字颠倒的原因，请求对方协助在系统里查找并更正，顺利拿到登机牌。

tgt: I'm really upset because the groomer cut my dog's fur unevenly and nicked his skin.
Can you fix this for your best groomer or give me a refund?
I love my pup so much, this makes me really worried about his comfort.
traps: 直接说"you hurt my dog"太情绪化，容易引起对立，地道说法应该先道歉再说明情况"I'm sorry to say but..."
用"I want you to pay me"太生硬，应该用"Can you cover the cost of vet care for the nick?"
忽略狗狗的状态，只说自己的不满，应该提到狗狗的不适让你担心
soc_bad_pet_groomer_mistake_cut.ai: Alex是宠物美容店的店长，他看到你抱着有问题的狗狗过来，立刻上前准备道歉并了解情况。
soc_bad_pet_groomer_mistake_cut.task: 礼貌地向店长说明狗狗被剪坏的情况并协商赔偿或补救措施

tgt: Oh gosh, I’m so sorry! I thought you were my colleague Tom who has the exact same backpack.
I didn’t mean to startle you, the backpack just caught my eye.
The train is coming soon, I’ll let you go now, sorry again!
traps: 拍肩膀的时候没有先示意就直接喊名字，在地铁这种拥挤场景下会让人感到冒犯，应该先轻拍肩膀再说话；
用"I recognize your backpack so I called you"，解释过于生硬，应该补充说明和朋友的相似点；
用"You are Tom"的错误猜测，应该用"I thought you were"来表达不确定
soc_name_train_passenger_mixup.ai: Alex是通勤的上班族，他不是Tom，此刻正摘下耳机回头看你。
soc_name_train_passenger_mixup.task: 道歉并解释误会，避免耽误列车发车

tgt: The dim sum here is some of the best in Guangzhou, have you tried their shrimp dumplings before?
It’s such a nice way to start the day with a casual chat over tea, how’s your week been going?
Quick check on the financial statements we asked for last week, have your team finalized the supplementary materials?
traps: 用“早茶”直译“morning tea”，地道的粤语早茶表达应该用“yum cha”或者“dim sum brunch”，符合本地职场场景
用“我需要你给我资料”直译“I need you to give me documents”，语气太强硬，地道说法应该用“quick check on the supplementary materials”
直接抢过对方的茶杯，显得没有礼貌，应该先给对方倒茶再开始对话
wk_small_guangzhou_tea.ai: Alex扮演目标公司财务总监Tony，他刚结束和广州本地海关的沟通，想先尝尝早茶点心，再和你确认财务尽调的资料补充要求。
wk_small_guangzhou_tea.task: 自然开启早茶场景的寒暄，回应对方的工作状态，确认资料补充

tgt: I just had my card replaced last month, and now it’s demagnetized again. Could you waive this reissue fee since it’s such a short time between replacements?
I don’t have my phone or cash with me right now, is there another way I can get into the gym to work out today?
Could you check my membership profile to confirm I only had one reissue before? I don’t want to pay twice for the same issue.
traps: 使用"My card is broken"，过于笼统，没有说明具体问题，地道的表达应该用"My membership card won’t scan at the entrance—it looks like it’s demagnetized"来准确描述故障。
使用"You must help me"，语气过于强硬，不符合服务沟通的原则，更合适的说法是"Could you please help me find a solution for today?"来请求协助。
使用直接指责的"You made my card demagnetized"，没有事实依据，应该改成"I’ve had issues with this card demagnetizing shortly after each reissue"来陈述自己的经历而非指责对方。
hob_gym_member_card_damage.ai: 前台Alex，他的立场是健身房的补卡政策是统一收取20元手续费，不管补办次数，他表示系统里显示你上个月刚补办过一次，无法免除费用，同时提醒你可以使用电子会员卡临时替代。
hob_gym_member_card_damage.task: 让Alex帮你免除这次的补卡费，或者找到其他进门的方式

tgt: I handled the box with extreme care on my way back to the hotel.
The damage seems to have occurred during the wrapping process.
Given that the exterior box is completely pristine, the vase must have cracked inside.
traps: 指责店员说 "You broke my vase when packaging."。在没有证据时直接指责对方，容易引起防御和争吵。应用被动语态委婉表达："It seems the item was damaged during wrapping."。
把“盒子完好无损”说成 "The box is very good, no touch."。这是典型中式英语，地道说法是 "The box is completely undamaged/intact."。
粗暴要求 "I want a new one or money back."。语气过冲，地道成熟的表达是 "I would appreciate an exchange or a full refund."。
life_shop_broken_souvenir.ai: 店员。坚称打包前是完好无损的，暗示是你自己在回酒店的路上（坐地铁或走路）不小心碰碎的，不予退换。
life_shop_broken_souvenir.task: 向店员解释你一路上极其小心、包装盒完全没有任何磕碰痕迹，说服其相信是打包时受力不均损坏，并要求换新或退款。

tgt: I have the live ticket right here in the official app, not just a screenshot.
It looks like there might be a double-booking or a technical glitch in the seating system.
Could you check with the box office to see which transaction was processed first?
traps: 对另一对夫妇说 "Go away"。这会显得你理亏。地道表达是 "I think there might be a mistake with the seating, let's wait for the usher"。
说 "I am the real buyer"。地道说法是 "I purchased this directly from the venue's website on March 12th"。
使用 "You must give me a new seat"。这显得很无理。应说 "If this can't be resolved, I'd hope for an equivalent seat elsewhere"。
talk_music_sydney_double.ai: 领座员Liam，他很困惑，因为系统显示该座只售出了一次，他怀疑其中一方的票有误。
talk_music_sydney_double.task: 展示你的官方购票APP记录而非截图，要求领座员找值班经理核实系统订单，并确保你能看到演出。

tgt: I think I was accidentally charged twice for this item.
Here is the receipt. As you can see, the organic strawberries are listed twice, but I only bought one box.
Could you help me process a refund for the extra one, please?
traps: 说 "You stole my money" 或 "Your machine cheated me"，这在英语里是非常严重的指控，显得极具攻击性。地道表达应用中性的 "charged twice" 或 "double charge"。
直译 "My money is wrong" 来表达账单不对。这属于典型的中式英语，地道说法应是 "There's an issue with my receipt" 或 "I noticed a billing mistake"。
使用 "Give me back my money"，这种祈使句听起来像在命令和威胁。地道、得体的退款请求应该用 "Could you please refund the difference?"。
soc_conflict_supermarket_overcharge.ai: Alex 扮演超市客服主管。他态度很温和，愿意帮你退款，但需要核对小票和核实你的商品。
soc_conflict_supermarket_overcharge.task: 向客服说明多扫了一次的情况，出示小票，并顺利拿到退款。

tgt: What if he loses interest after just a couple of months?
A $4,500 investment seems a bit steep for a beginner.
Is there a middle ground, like a high-end digital piano or a rental?
traps: 说 'The price is too steep' 时忘了加 a。地道表达是 'That's a bit steep'。
用 'I want to save money'。这显得抠门，用 'I'd rather be a bit more cautious with such a big purchase' 更好。
说 'The kid is small'。形容年龄通常用 'At his age' 或 'For a beginner'。
soc_partner_piano_choice.ai: Alex。立场是：既然决定学就要一步到位，二手琴或电钢琴会毁了孩子的听力感悟和手指力度感。
soc_partner_piano_choice.task: 顶住压力，提议先租琴（Rent-to-own）或者买一台成色好的二手中等价位琴。

tgt: That thoughtful breakfast spread in the fridge was an absolute life-saver!
I brought some fine tea from home, and I'd love for you to have it.
Thank you so much for making my first night here so comfortable.
traps: 想表达「你心肠真好」说成 "You are a warm-hearted landlord"，听起来像书面教科书翻译，地道口语常用 "That was so thoughtful of you"。
将「送给你」说成 "I present this tea to you"，"present" 语气过于正式庄重（多用于颁奖或官方赠送），日常送礼用 "I'd love for you to have this"。
想说「冰箱里的食物」直接说 "food in the fridge"，表达略显随意粗糙，用 "the breakfast spread in the fridge" 更显优雅地道。
life_gift_landlord_welcome.ai: Alex，和蔼可亲的房东。关心你昨晚睡得好不好，很高兴你喜欢他准备的早餐食材。
life_gift_landlord_welcome.task: 表达对房东 Alex 贴心准备食物的感谢，并将茶叶作为见面礼送给他。

tgt: This continuous drizzle is driving me crazy; my sneakers are completely soaked.
Do you know of any reliable shoe stores nearby where I can pick up a pair of waterproof boots?
How do locals survive weeks of this non-stop moisture without losing their minds?
traps: 说成 'It is always raining here, I really hate this weather.' 显得过于绝对和抱怨，地道表达会用 'This endless drizzle is driving me crazy.'。
问 'Where can I buy good shoes?' 太笼统，地道表达会用 'Where can I pick up a pair of waterproof boots?'。
说 'How do people live here with this rain?' 语法虽对但略显生硬，地道表达会用 'How do locals survive weeks of this non-stop moisture?'。
talk_weather_vancouver_autumn_rain.ai: Alex 扮演纪念品店的本地店员，为人热情。他见你湿漉漉的，主动跟你吐槽温哥华今年入秋以来的超长雨季，并关心你有没有带防水装备。
talk_weather_vancouver_autumn_rain.task: 向店员抱怨这糟糕的天气打乱了你的行程，顺便打听附近哪里能买到质量好一点的雨靴。

tgt: These herbal home remedies might not be safe for long-term use.
Even natural herbs can put pressure on your kidneys.
Let's ask a real doctor at the hospital first just to be safe.
traps: 将‘民间偏方’直译为 "bias recipe"。"Bias" 是偏见的意思，‘偏方’在英语里通常被称为 "home remedies"、"folk remedies" 或 "unverified herbal recipes"。
对长辈直接说 "This video is false"（这个视频是假的）。这种语气过于生硬和具有攻击性，容易引起逆反心理，地道的委婉表达可以用 "The videos online aren't always reliable"。
把‘吃药/喝药’说成 "eat medicine"。英文中无论是西药片还是中药汤剂，动词一律用 "take"，比如 "take medicine" 或 "take herbs"。
soc_elder_herbal_tea.ai: 姑姑。非常注重养生，觉得视频里那个‘专家’讲得很专业，而且是纯天然草药，觉得晚辈太迷信西医。
soc_elder_herbal_tea.task: 劝说姑姑暂停饮用自制草药水，并陪她去医院做个正规咨询。

tgt: I noticed this hairline scratch on the sensor during my initial inspection.
Can we check the timestamped photos from your pre-rental check?
I'd like to have this documented in the agreement before I leave the shop.
traps: 不要说 "You are lying"。用地道的怀疑句 "I'm fairly certain the scratch was there when I opened the case"。
划痕不是 "hole" 或 "break"，是 "scratch"。如果是极细的划痕叫 "hairline scratch"。
避免说 "Change one for me"。地道的表达是 "Could I get a replacement unit, please?"。
hob_photo_london_rental.ai: Alex 担心损失，表现得有些防御性，他认为是你在刚才试机的一分钟内操作不当造成的。
hob_photo_london_rental.task: 坚持立场，指出划痕在自检前就存在，要求更换一台机器或者在租赁合同上备注此瑕疵以避免归还时的赔偿。

tgt: I sanitized the unit with alcohol wipes after every single use.
I never wear perfume, so that scent could not have originated from me.
Please compare its current state with the check-out inspection photos.
traps: 直译“用酒精棉片消毒”为 'clean it with spirit paper'，酒精棉片地道说法是 'alcohol wipes' 或 'alcohol prep pads'。
表示“这个味道不是我弄的”说成 'this smell is not my making'，地道表达是 'that scent didn't come from me' 或 'originated from me'。
表示“出租时的照片”说成 'out-store photos'，地道说法是 'check-out inspection photos' 或 'initial condition photos'。
hob_sing_gear_rental_cleaning_fee.ai: Alex 是乐器租赁店店员，坚持按设备归还检验标准扣费，态度死板，声称嗅觉和肉眼检查均未通过。
hob_sing_gear_rental_cleaning_fee.task: 澄清自己未使用香水并已妥善清洁，要求店经理重新比对发货时的检验记录，免除无理的清洗费用。

tgt: How did they manage to align the entire pyramid with the equinox?
Is it true that the shadow looks like a snake slithering down?
Their knowledge of astronomy was way ahead of its time.
traps: 动词搭配不当：说成 'how did they make the pyramid align'，用 'manage to align' 更自然。
动词选择错误：说成 'shadow looks like a snake walking down'，蛇爬行应用 'slithering down'。
固定短语误用：想表达‘超越时代’，说成 'too advanced than time'，地道说法是 'ahead of its time'。
talk_history_acapulco_maya.ai: Tom 扮演一位玛雅文明研究者，正向你解释金字塔台阶数量与玛雅太阳历的精妙对应关系。
talk_history_acapulco_maya.task: 向 Tom 请教玛雅人当年是如何精确计算出这些天文历法的。

tgt: Don't worry, I won't spoil anything.
It has a really mind-bending twist at the end.
It really makes you question our relationship with technology.
traps: 表达“不会剧透”时，不要直译为 "I won't tell you the end"，用 "No spoilers!" 或者 "I won't spoil it for you" 更地道。
不要将“脑洞大”硬译成 "big brain hole"，英文里常用 "mind-bending" 或 "highly imaginative" 来形容这种科幻概念。
表达“保密”时，不用生硬的 "I promise I don't speak"，可以使用俏皮生动的地道表达 "My lips are sealed"。
talk_movie_host_spoiler.ai: Ben，幽默健谈的房东。他想知道这一集是否值得他花一个小时观看，但非常介意被提前告知反转和结局。
talk_movie_host_spoiler.task: 向他保证你绝对不会剧透，在不透露具体剧情的前提下，用抽象的词汇（如脑洞大、引人深思）告诉他这一集非常值得一看。

tgt: I had a blast today, but I'm really just looking for a one-off experience right now.
I'm not ready to commit to a multi-week course at this stage.
Let me take the flyer home and think about it, but please don't hold a spot for me.
traps: 说“I have no money”（我没钱），不仅尴尬而且容易给对方留下推销分期付款的口实；地道回应宜强调意愿不匹配，如“It's a bit more of a commitment than I'm looking for”。
表达“I will call you if I want”（我想去就会打给你），直译感重且语气过于生硬；地道客套应说“I'll definitely let you know if my schedule opens up.”
误将“one-off”（一次性的）说成“one-time class”且混淆为“once time”；地道口语描述单次体验用“a one-off workshop”或“a single drop-in session”。
soc_decline_pottery_course.ai: Alex 是陶艺工作室店长。他夸赞你的手工潜质，不断强调该课程名额只剩最后 2 个，试图说服你现场交定金报名。
soc_decline_pottery_course.task: 认可今天的体验非常有趣，但明确表示自己暂时没有长期的课程规划，坚决不上钩交定金，礼貌拒绝推销。

tgt: The 80-dollar seats actually have a much better view of the whole stage.
I’m a bit worried the floor seats will be too crowded and loud.
Are you guys okay with the grandstand area instead?
traps: 内场票不要直译为 'Inside tickets'，地道说法是 'Floor seats' 或 'Pit tickets'。
看台不要说 'Sitting area'，地道说法是 'Grandstand' 或 'Bleachers'。
想近距离看不说 'Look it near'，地道说法是 'Get a closer look' 或 'Be close to the stage'。
soc_group_concert_seating.ai: Alex 是超级粉丝，他很想买内场票近距离看偶像，但如果大家都选看台，他也可以接受。
soc_group_concert_seating.task: 向 Alex 解释为什么 80 美元的看台票性价比更高，并最终达成共识。

tgt: Excuse me, would you mind giving up your seat for this gentleman? He's having a hard time standing.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you please let him sit? He looks quite exhausted.
Thank you for understanding, it's a big help for him.
traps: 说成 'You must stand up' 是命令，应说 'Would you mind giving up your seat?'。
说成 'You are young, he is old' 是道德绑架，应说 'He's having a hard time standing'。
说成 'Get up now' 语气极其粗鲁，应说 'Could you please...?'。
life_help_bus_seat.ai: Alex 扮演那个年轻人，被你打断后显得很不耐烦，觉得老人应该去坐专门的轮椅位。
life_help_bus_seat.task: 委婉但坚定地请他给老人让座

tgt: I just moved into Room 502 next door and wanted to say hello.
This is a traditional savory pancake from my hometown.
Don't worry, there are absolutely no peanuts or nuts in it.
traps: 把“打个招呼”直译为 “I want to make a call with you”，这在英语里是打电话的意思，邻居见面打招呼应该用 “say hello” 或 “introduce myself”。
把“请你尝尝”说成 “I want you to eat this”，听起来像命令，不够礼貌，地道的说法是 “I wanted to share some... with you” 或 “I thought you might want to try some”。
表达“没有花生”时说 “It doesn't have peanuts inside”，虽然语法对但不够正式安全，涉及过敏（allergy）时，用 “It's completely peanut-free” 会让对方更放心。
talk_memory_neighbor_food.ai: Alex 是个热情的英国小伙，对中国食物很感兴趣。但他对花生严重过敏，需要确认食物里的成分安全。
talk_memory_neighbor_food.task: 友好地送出食物，解释这是你家乡的特色，并用英文确认里面绝对没有他过敏的成分。

tgt: I am the designated Finance Lead for this JV, with extensive experience in IFRS conversions and regional tax planning.
In my previous tenure, I managed the financial integration of three $50M+ cross-border entities.
My focus for FY26F is to establish a transparent reporting line that satisfies both parent companies' audit requirements.
traps: 不要说 'I will do the accounting work'。在总监级别，应说 'I will spearhead the financial reporting and tax optimization efforts'。
避免直译 'I am sent by the Chinese company'。地道说法是 'I am the designated Finance Lead from the [Company Name] side'。
不要把 'both sides' 挂在嘴边。地道说法是 'bilateral reporting requirements' 或 'satisfying the requirements of both parent entities'。
wk_intro_jv_finance_alignment.ai: Alex 扮演对方派驻的财务总监，他担心合资公司在跨境利润分配和税务合规上存在盲区。他希望你表现出对双边准则（IFRS vs Local GAAP）的专业度。
wk_intro_jv_finance_alignment.task: 建立专业信任感，介绍你在多准则报表合并及跨境税务合规方面的资历。

tgt: It was an honest mistake, please don't beat yourself up.
Your safety and well-being are way more important than this flight.
We will figure this out together, step by step.
traps: 说 "Why were you so careless?"（你怎么这么不小心？），在危机时刻怪罪对方是沟通禁忌，地道表达应为 "Accidents happen, we are in this together."
说 "You ruined our trip!"（你毁了我们的旅行！），会让对方更加绝望自责，地道表达应为 "Flights can be rescheduled, we will be okay."
说 "Don't cry, it's useless."（别哭了，没用），直接打压情绪，地道表达应为 "Let it out, but know that I'm not leaving your side."
soc_comfort_travel_partner_lost_passport.ai: Alex 扮演你的同行好友。她对自己的粗心感到自责与绝望，觉得整个假期都被自己毁了，情绪极度激动。
soc_comfort_travel_partner_lost_passport.task: 化解她的自责与绝望情绪，让她重新冷静下来，并共同应对应急方案。

tgt: That looks like a heavy box! Are you shipping it far?
I always find the post office so busy on Saturdays.
Do they charge a lot for international shipping?
traps: 不要说 'The box is very heavy, right?'，应用 'That looks like a heavy box!' 更自然。
不要说 'Is the post office busy every Saturday?'，应说 'I always find it so busy...'。
不要说 'Is the shipping money high?'，应说 'Do they charge a lot for shipping?'。
life_smalltalk_post_office.ai: Alex 站在你前面，他正要把礼物寄回老家，看起来有点费力。
life_smalltalk_post_office.task: 主动询问对方是否需要帮忙，或者聊聊寄东西的频率。

tgt: Hi, could I get a decaf latte, please?
I'm trying to avoid regular caffeine because my sleep schedule is completely ruined by jet lag.
Could you make it with oat milk if you have it?
traps: 点咖啡说 'I want decaf coffee' 太过简单，地道说法是 'could I get a decaf latte, please?'。
说咖啡因过多用 'too much caffeine' 可以，但为了表达对失眠的影响，用 'avoid regular caffeine' 更合适。
问有没有燕麦奶说 'Do you have oat milk?' 没问题，加上 'if you have it' 显得更有礼貌余地。
hob_sleep_bakery_decaf_latte.ai: Alex 是咖啡师。他微笑着点头确认，并询问你要脱脂奶还是全脂奶。
hob_sleep_bakery_decaf_latte.task: 向咖啡师点一杯低因拿铁并说明要求

tgt: My booking confirmation explicitly states that one piece of sports equipment is included at no extra charge.
Could you please double-check the 'special handling' section of my reservation?
I have the digital receipt here showing the pre-paid 'Sports Plus' package.
traps: 说 You are wrong。这会让对话陷入僵局。地道说法是 There might be a discrepancy between my record and yours。
说 I don't give you money。这听起来像是在抢劫现场。地道说法是 I believe this fee should be waived according to my policy。
将冲浪板说成 big thing。地道说法是 oversized sports equipment 或 surfboard case。
life_air_surfboard_fee.ai: 柜台值机员。他系统里显示的只是普通机票，看不到你的附加套餐信息，正准备刷你的信用卡。
life_air_surfboard_fee.task: 据理力争，要求他重新核查你的订单详情或寻求上级确认，避免支付这 200 美元。

tgt: I'd like to apply for a library card, please.
How many books can I check out at a time?
What's the loan period for these health magazines?
traps: 说 'I want to borrow a card' 会引起误解，应说 'apply for a library card'。
说 'How many books can I borrow?' 可以，但用 'check out' 更符合图书馆语境。
说 'How long can I hold the books?' 不够地道，应问 'What is the loan period?'
hob_read_library_card.ai: 图书馆管理员，耐心指导你填写申请表，并说明借阅期限为3周。
hob_read_library_card.task: 完成借书证申请并了解借阅规则

tgt: That sounds like a wonderful memory, but I really need to dive back into these notes before 4 PM.
I appreciate you sharing that, but I've got to focus hard to finish this chapter.
It's a great story, but I better get back to work so I can finish before the library closes.
traps: 使用 'This is a library, don't talk!'，虽然图书馆要安静，但用祈使句训斥老人在英语中显得极其刻薄，地道的做法是说自己需要专注于笔记。
使用 'Your story is annoying me.'，直接人身攻击对方的聊天，在英语社交中极其少见且粗暴，应用 'I appreciate you sharing that, but...' 来化解。
使用 'Keep quiet please.'，语气像是在当管理员管教别人，会引发不必要的冲突，应当把原因归结为自己的时间压力。
talk_end_library_desk.ai: Alex 扮演图书馆里的怀旧老人，正沉浸在回忆中并向你倾诉。
talk_end_library_desk.task: 体恤对方的怀旧情绪，但表明自己必须抓紧时间闭门赶工

tgt: That sounds like a great trip, but I'm going to do my own thing this time.
It's not the price — I just travel better on my own.
Thanks for thinking of me, though. I hope you have a brilliant time.
traps: 别用 'I have no time' 挡回去，太生硬，而且这里也不是真的没时间。要么 'I won't be able to make it'，要么直接说实话 'I'd rather travel on my own.'
'I'm not convenient that day' 是「我那天不方便」的直译，convenient 不能用来形容人。地道说法是 'That day doesn't work for me.'
'I will consider it' 在英语里听起来像九成会去，对方会一路追着要答复。真不去就说 'I'll pass on this one, but thank you.'
soc_decline_seatmate_tour.ai: Alex 演邻座 Diane，六十多岁，热心、话多、没有任何算计。她先就事论事讲这个团多划算（含两顿晚餐和一个酒庄）；你说没空，她就问你哪天有空；你说想自己走，她说可以帮你跟领队要一天自由活动。她是一层层帮你解决问题，不是在为难你。
soc_decline_seatmate_tour.task: 把不参团这件事说死，谢过她的好意，还要让接下来落地前的一小时和取行李时不尴尬。

tgt: That sounds like a rough few months. I'm glad you told me.
I've got a class starting in four minutes, but I'm around Thursday if you fancy a coffee after.
Genuinely — go easy on yourself this week.
traps: 'I'm sorry to hear that. Anyway, I go to my class now.'——'Anyway' 紧跟在共情后面会把那句共情一笔勾销，而且 'I go' 时态也不对。先把共情说完、停一拍，再交代要走：'…I've got to head into my class.'
'Don't be sad.' / 'Everything will be fine.' 是哄小孩的语气。成年人之间说 'That's a lot to be carrying' 或 'That sounds really hard.'
'I must leave now, bye bye.'——must 太重，'bye bye' 在成年人之间偏幼稚。收口用 'I've got to run — take care, mate.'
talk_end_locker_divorce.ai: Alex 演常客 Greg，四十多岁，不是来博同情，他只是憋得难受、随手找了个听得进去的人。他不会不高兴，但你要是只回一句 'OK, bye' 他会明显尴尬。
talk_end_locker_divorce.task: 既让他觉得被听见，又能在四分钟内进那节课，还不让以后见面变尴尬。

tgt: I'll scramble the eggs first, take them out, then cook the tomatoes and put the eggs back in at the end.
Turn the heat right up — the eggs need to go in when the oil's really hot.
A pinch of sugar isn't to make it sweet, it just takes the sourness off the tomatoes.
traps: 中式的「炒蛋」别说成 "fry the egg" —— 那是煎荷包蛋。打散了炒是 scramble："scramble the eggs"，青菜肉类那种大火快炒才叫 stir-fry。
「开大火」别直译成 "open the fire big." —— 英语用 heat 不用 fire："turn the heat up" 或 "turn it up to high."
别说 "Put a little sugar, will be more delicious." —— 少了主语，而且 delicious 已经是最高级的形容词，前面不加 more。说 "Add a bit of sugar and it'll taste better."
talk_memory_friend_mom_kitchen.ai: 朋友的妈妈 Alex，平时就爱做菜，对别人的做法特别好奇。会问先下蛋还是先下番茄、要不要放糖、火开多大，也会讲自己平时怎么做，气氛很轻松。
talk_memory_friend_mom_kitchen.task: 一边做一边把每一步用英语讲清楚，让她看完能自己在家复现这道菜。

tgt: I'm looking for something for an eight-year-old — nothing too scary.
Is there anything in it that might upset her?
When are these due back? Can I return them on a Sunday?
traps: 「借」说成 "Can you borrow me two DVDs?" —— borrow 是「借入」。要么 "Can I borrow these?"，要么 "Can you lend me…?"
「会不会太吓人」说成 "Will she afraid?" —— 缺动词，方向也反了。要说 "Will it scare her?" / "Is it too scary for her?"
「适合小孩」总说 "suitable for children" —— 书面腔。口语说 "kid-friendly" / "fine for kids" 更自然。
talk_movie_library_kids.ai: Alex 是图书馆管理员，见惯了大人来问这个，会主动问孩子多大、有什么不能看的，然后给两三个选择。
talk_movie_library_kids.task: 说清孩子年龄和「不能太吓人」的要求，问清借期和怎么还，最后选定两张。

tgt: I’ve accidentally locked myself out and seem to have misplaced the house key.
Is there a spare key available, or should I call a locksmith?
I am happy to cover the costs for the lock change.
traps: 容易说成 'I lost the door key'，用 'misplaced' 听起来更像是不小心遗失而非由于粗心丢失。
常说 'I pay the money for the lock'，地道说法是 'I’ll cover the expenses/costs'。
问 'Do you have another one?' 有歧义，应具体为 'Do you have a spare key?'
life_lost_keys_airbnb.ai: Airbnb房东。担心房屋安全，希望尽快解决，并告知你更换锁芯的费用。态度客观但立场坚定。
life_lost_keys_airbnb.task: 向房东说明情况并询问是否有备用钥匙或维修方案。

tgt: These beans have unique floral notes that you can't get from standard roasts.
I usually brew it manually to enjoy the subtle flavors.
It's a small treat for myself on the weekends.
traps: 把咖啡‘风味’说成 'taste of coffee'，品鉴咖啡时地道用词是 'flavor notes' 或 'flavor profile'。
把‘手冲咖啡’说成 'I make coffee by my hand'，地道说法是 'pour-over coffee' 或 'hand drip'。
说 'It's cheap' 来表达划算，如果是指高品质下的性价比，更地道的表达是 'good value for money'.
talk_shopop_melbourne_coffee.ai: Alex 扮演合租室友。他也是咖啡爱好者但偏向实用主义，觉得 45 澳元一包太夸张，想听听你的品鉴想法。
talk_shopop_melbourne_coffee.task: 说明这包特殊咖啡豆的价值所在，并聊聊日常生活中偶尔“犒劳自己”的消费逻辑。

tgt: We might need a healer for this domain, we keep dying.
Alex, could you switch to Kokomi? We have enough DPS.
I'll go with a support if you want to keep Diluc.
traps: 不要说 "We need a doctor"，游戏里的回复角色叫 "healer"。
不要说 "Change your person"，切换角色用地道的 "switch character" 或 "swap to..."。
避免说 "Your blood is little"，形容角色血量低用 "low HP" 或 "half health"。
hob_video_genshin_coop.ai: 房主 Alex，他选了迪卢克（Diluc），很想打伤害，但其实他也有满级的珊瑚宫心海（Kokomi）。
hob_video_genshin_coop.task: 建议 Alex 换个奶妈（Healer），否则这关 90 级的怪大家扛不住。

tgt: I bought this as a gift for a baby shower, but I just found the base is cracked.
It was already broken inside the box when I opened it today.
Since it was defective upon purchase, I would like to exchange it for a new one.
traps: 说成 'The toy's foot is broken.' 玩具的底座一般不说 foot，应该说 'base'。
说成 'I want to change a good one.'，‘change a good one’ 是典型的中式直译，正确说法是 'exchange it for a new one'。
说成 'Your store sold me a bad thing.'，‘bad thing’ 词汇太幼稚，商品有质量问题应用 'defective item'。
soc_congrats_baby_shower_gift_broken.ai: Alex 是玩具店店员。他检查后说商品已经拆封且超过了退换货的常规期限，只能提供8折优惠券。
soc_congrats_baby_shower_gift_broken.task: 解释这是作为婴儿派对的祝福礼物，且买来时里面就是坏的，要求直接更换一个完好的同款商品。

tgt: For a year and a half, two hundred and twenty is a lot better value than six hundred for a new one.
It's used, but it's solid wood and the cushions are still firm — I think it's worth the money.
If I can sell it on for even a hundred when I leave, it basically costs me nothing.
traps: 别说 "It's very worth." —— worth 后面必须带东西，不能单独结句。说 "It's worth the money." 或 "It's worth every penny."；「值得买」是 "It's worth buying."，不是 "worth to buy"。
别把「性价比」直译成 "The cost performance is high." —— 英语母语者不这么说，听着像产品说明书。地道说法是 "It's good value for money." 或 "You get a lot for your money."
别说 "I spent 220 dollars to buy this sofa." —— spend 的固定搭配是 spend + 钱 + on + 物，或 spend + 钱 + doing。说 "I spent 220 dollars on this sofa."
talk_shopop_used_sofa.ai: Alex 是你的合租室友，跟你一起逛的店。他先绕着沙发看了看、按了按坐垫，觉得成色不错，但担心二手沙发有味道、也不知道能不能搬进你们那个窄楼梯。他想帮你把账算明白，不是拦着你买。
talk_shopop_used_sofa.task: 把你的算账逻辑讲清楚（只住一年半、走的时候还能转手），听 Alex 的顾虑，最后和他一起定下买不买、怎么运回去。

tgt: I'm having trouble activating my eSIM; the QR code isn't working.
It keeps giving me an error message saying 'Unable to Activate'.
Could you help me activate it manually?
traps: 把“扫不上二维码”说成“I can't scan the barcode”。二维码是“QR code”，而“barcode”是超市商品上的条形码，两者不能混用。
描述手机报错时，直译“My phone has an error”。地道说法是“My phone is showing an error message”或“I keep getting an error”。
把“手动激活”说成“by my hand”。地道表达是“manually”或“enter the details manually”。
life_phone_esim_activation.ai: Alex 是 T-Mobile 实体店的店员。态度友善，表示这个情况很常见，会帮你手动输入激活码，或者重新生成一个二维码。
life_phone_esim_activation.task: 向店员说明你买的 eSIM 扫码失败，出示确认邮件，并配合店员在手机上完成手动激活。

tgt: My rear light just ran out of battery five minutes ago, and I was looking for a place to pull over safely.
I have a spare headlamp in my pack that I can mount immediately to ensure visibility.
My hotel is less than 500 meters down this street; I'm happy to push the bike the rest of the way.
traps: 说 'My light has no energy' 指电量耗尽，中式表达，地道说法是 'My light ran out of battery' 或 'The battery died'。
用 'I push bike walk to hotel' 表达推车走，语法破碎，地道说法是 'I can walk the bike to the hotel'。
说 'Don't give me the fine please!' 语气过于乞求且不规范，地道说法是 'Could you please give me a break this time since I'm almost at my destination?'。
hob_bike_police_night_riding.ai: 执勤交警 Alex。执法态度专业严肃，重视道路安全，对违反夜间骑行灯光法律行为零容忍，但会听取合理解释。
hob_bike_police_night_riding.task: 说明尾灯是5分钟前刚好没电，展示包内备用头灯并承诺步行回仅剩500米的酒店，争取取消罚单。

tgt: I didn't expect the temperature to drop so sharply overnight.
Is this kind of late-spring chill typical for this time of year?
Do you happen to know if there's a convenience store nearby to grab something warm?
traps: 常说 'The weather becomes cold'，地道表达应为 'The temperature has dropped'。
常问 'Is this weather normal?'，语气略显生硬，建议用 'Is this typical for...'。
常说 'I have cold'，这会被误解为感冒，应说 'I am freezing' 或 'I'm shivering'。
talk_weather_tokyo_cherry_blossom.ai: Alex是当地退休居民，他想劝你趁天没完全黑赶紧去坐地铁，因为晚上的体感温度会更低。
talk_weather_tokyo_cherry_blossom.task: 与老爷爷探讨这种反常的天气，并询问周围哪里有卖暖贴或热饮的地方。

tgt: I need to transfer 2,200 Euros to this language school.
How long will it take for the funds to reach their account?
Is there a wire transfer fee for this transaction?
traps: 给学校打钱不要只说 'Give money to school'，转账应使用 'Transfer funds' 或 'Make a wire transfer'。
不要混淆 'Fee' 和 'Price'。银行的服务费是 'fee'，不是汇款的 'price'。
问什么时候到账不要说 'When can they see the money?'，地道问法是 'When will the funds be credited to the recipient's account?'。
life_bank_dublin_tuition.ai: Alex 是银行柜员，会帮你核对收款人的 IBAN 账号和 BIC 代码，并确认汇款用途。
life_bank_dublin_tuition.task: 提供汇款单信息，确认资金何时到账，并支付汇款手续费。

tgt: I received a 24-hour shutoff notice, but this outstanding balance belongs to the previous tenant.
I moved in on the 1st of this month, and my lease agreement proves start of occupancy.
Could you please put a stay on the disconnection order while we update the account details?
traps: 把断电通知直译为 'stop power paper'，地道说法是 'shutoff notice' 或 'disconnection notice'。
把欠费直译为 'old money'，地道表达应为 'outstanding balance' 或 'overdue amount'。
说 'Don't cut my power' 过于口语化且缺乏力度，地道请求暂缓断电应使用 'put a stay on the disconnection order'。
life_neigh_electricity_shutoff_notice.ai: 电力公司客服 Alex。核查系统显示该电表确实存在逾期账单，需要按照程序在明天上午 9 点执行断电，除非收到清偿或身份变更凭证。
life_neigh_electricity_shutoff_notice.task: 说明自己是新租客并提供起租日期，要求暂停断电指令（Stay the disconnection），并将账单转移至前租客/房东。

tgt: That sounds like a complicated order, but it might be worth it!
Are you a regular here? I can never decide what to get.
I usually just stick to the basics, but that looks interesting.
traps: 说成 'You order too many things.'，显得多管闲事，用 'That sounds like a complicated order' 仅作评价。
说成 'Do you come here every day?'，有点查户口，用 'Are you a regular here?' 更自然。
说成 'I don't like complex drinks.'，太自我，用 'I usually just stick to the basics' 表达自己的喜好。
life_smalltalk_cafeteria_wait.ai: Alex 是位挑剔的顾客，他正在试图定制一杯生酮饮食友好的咖啡。
life_smalltalk_cafeteria_wait.task: 在对方确认完后，顺口提一句关于定制咖啡的话题。

tgt: Could you please press this sandwich a little longer so the bread gets extra crispy?
I'd like it toasted twice until the cheese is fully melted and golden brown.
I don't mind if the edges get slightly burnt, I love that crunchy texture.
traps: 说成 "Toast it more heavy." 语法错误，副词和形容词混淆，地道说法是 "toast it a little longer" 或 "extra crispy"。
双面烤透说成 "Toast both two sides." 语义重复，直接说 "toast it twice" 或 "press it longer"。
表达不介意烤焦说成 "I am not caring if it's black." 表达很奇怪，应该说 "I don't mind if it gets slightly charred"。
life_eat_sandwich_toast_twice.ai: Alex 扮演三明治店员，正在切面包。他微笑着点头，并提醒你多烤两分钟可能会让边缘的芝士稍微有点烤焦，问你介不介意。
life_eat_sandwich_toast_twice.task: 向店员强调需要将三明治彻底加热并双面烤脆，并表示不介意轻微烤焦

tgt: I'd love to join the toast, but I'm actually allergic to alcohol.
I'm the designated rider tonight, so I have to stick to non-alcoholic drinks.
How about I get a ginger ale and we still cheers?
traps: 直译‘我不喝’为 'I don't drink'。在酒吧被劝酒时，单说 'I don't drink' 语气生硬，听起来像在进行道德评判。地道说法是 'I'm not drinking tonight'（我今晚不喝）或 'I'm staying dry tonight'。
表达‘酒精过敏’错用 'My body cannot take alcohol'。这听起来像宿醉或酒量差。应该用地道的 'I'm allergic to alcohol' 或 'Alcohol doesn't agree with me'。
把‘扫兴’直译为 'I don't want to kill the happy'。这完全是中式英语。可以用 'I don't mean to be a party pooper, but...' 或 'I hate to spoil the fun, but...' 来委婉切入。
hob_wine_pub_peer_pressure.ai: 热情但有些强势的本地跑友，认为‘不喝健力士就不算来过爱尔兰’，觉得你在扫兴。
hob_wine_pub_peer_pressure.task: 坚定拒绝这杯酒，解释身体原因和安全顾虑，并说服对方帮你换成无酒精啤酒或姜汁汽水。

tgt: Two of the cups arrived shattered despite the fragile label.
I was assured that standard packing would be sufficient for these items.
Given the value, a full shipping refund doesn't cover the loss of the product.
traps: 说成 'My cups are broken, you pay me.'，地道说法是 'Two of the items arrived damaged, and I would like to file a claim.'。
说成 'You tell me it is safe.'，地道说法是 'I was assured that the packaging was adequate.'。
说成 'I want my money back.'，地道说法是 'I am looking for a fair resolution regarding the damaged goods.'
life_post_damaged_ceramics.ai: 快递站经理，坚持当时你没有购买额外保险（Insured shipping），因此只愿赔付运费。
life_post_damaged_ceramics.task: 指出包装时对方承诺过有基本防护，要求合理的破损补偿。

tgt: I have no doubt that Swiss medicine is high quality, but I need to be very careful with the ingredients.
Could we compare the active ingredients of both brands side by side?
I'm willing to pay more if the formula is identical, but I have some allergies to consider.
traps: 误将 '成分' 说成 'things'，地道术语是 'ingredients' 或 'components'。
语气生硬地问 'Are they same?'，应说 'Is the active ingredient profile identical?'。
直译 'I'm afraid of dying'，地道说法是 'I have a history of allergic reactions'。
talk_agree_pharmacy_generic.ai: Alex 是专业的药剂师。他非常自信地推销本土品牌，认为其纯度更高、副作用更小，不断强调其品质。
talk_agree_pharmacy_generic.task: 达成部分同意：认可药品品质，但在确认成分比例（dosage/ingredients）前拒绝购买。

tgt: Hi, sorry to bother you. I'm wondering if a box of fruit addressed to me might have been accidentally delivered to your door.
The delivery app says it was dropped off yesterday afternoon, but I couldn't find it downstairs.
Could you take a quick look inside your apartment just in case?
traps: 一上来就说‘You stole my package’（你偷了我的包裹）。在事情没查清前用 stole 会直接激化矛盾，应用 accidentally delivered 表现出怀疑是误拿。
把‘快递包裹’直译为 express package。在北美或海外日常中，通常直接用 package、box 或是 delivery。
用‘Give me my package back’。语气像是在讨债或抓小偷，地道说法是 Could you take a quick look inside your apartment just in case 更礼貌体面。
soc_nb_stolen_delivery.ai: Alex 住在同楼层，刚好开门拿外卖。看到你在走廊张望，他热心地问你是不是在找什么东西。
soc_nb_stolen_delivery.task: 向邻居询问是否误拿了你的快递包裹。

tgt: The lead singer's voice gave me chills during that last scene.
Looks like the second act is about to start.
I'd better head back to my seat, enjoy the rest of the show!
traps: 想说“让我起鸡皮疙瘩”，直译成 'It made my goosebumps.' 属于语法错误。正确说法是 'It gave me goosebumps.' 或 'I got goosebumps.'。
铃声响时说 'The bell is calling me.' 显得诡异。地道表达可以说 'That's the bell for Act 2.'。
告别时说 'Goodbye forever.' 过于悲壮死板。剧院场景下简单的 'Enjoy the second half!' 即可。
life_party_west_end_theatre.ai: Alex 扮演一位资深剧迷，性格随和且谈吐优雅，追问你对今晚演出的看法。
life_party_west_end_theatre.task: 用英文分享一句对演出的简单评价，并在催促铃声响起时自然结束对话回到座位。

tgt: Bright yellow is quite bold, but I'm afraid it might be a bit overwhelming for the living room.
I personally prefer dark grey as it creates a more cozy and sophisticated atmosphere.
Why don't we get some samples of both colors and see how they look on the wall?
traps: 说成 'Yellow is ugly'。评论他人的喜好时，用 'overwhelming' 或 'not quite my style' 比直接说 'ugly' 有礼貌。
说成 'Grey is better'。应说 'I prefer...'，表达个人审美而非客观事实。
说成 'Look at the wall'。应说 'see how they look on the wall'，这样更完整且地道。
soc_partner_wall_color.ai: Alex 认为亮黄色能让公寓看起来更有活力，他已经在网上买了样板漆。
soc_partner_wall_color.task: 评价对方的颜色选择，并推销你的方案。

tgt: What historical cohort data supports the assumption that customer acquisition costs will remain flat despite a 50% increase in ad spend?
How does the projected LTV-to-CAC ratio for FY26F compare against our actual performance in 9M26?
Can we model the downside scenario where the blended CAC increases by 20% due to rising digital media bidding prices?
traps: 把历史客户群体数据说成 'history customer data' 不够地道，专业术语是 'historical cohort data'。
谈到生命周期价值与获客成本比率时误用全称拼写，直接用行业缩写 'LTV-to-CAC ratio' 更自然。
表达数字媒体竞价时误用 'bidding price for internet ads'，地道商务表达是 'digital media bidding prices'。
dd_fcst_marketing_roi.ai: Alex 扮演目标公司市场增长总监。他解释新渠道投放效率更高，并预计通过算法优化将边际获客成本维持在合理区间。
dd_fcst_marketing_roi.task: 评估市场获客成本预测的审慎性，并测试若CAC上升20%对整体盈利的敏感性

tgt: Sorry to bother you, but what you just ordered looks incredible!
I'm a bit overwhelmed by the menu—what's your go-to here?
I'm looking for something with a bit of a kick, but not too spicy.
traps: 问 'Which number did you buy?'。在餐车点单通常用 'order' 而不是 'buy'，地道问法是 'Which number was that?'。
形容辣味只知道 'spicy'。地道说法包括 'has a kick'（够劲）、'mild'（微辣）、'blow your head off'（超级辣）。
说 'I don't want too much hot'。应说 'not too spicy' 或 'keep it mild'，'hot' 虽然也指辣，但通常指热度或极端的辣。
life_smalltalk_foodtruck_order.ai: 这里的熟客 Alex，每周五都会来买 2 号餐加牛油果酱，对每种辣酱的辣度了如指掌。
life_smalltalk_foodtruck_order.task: 询问他点的是菜单上的哪一项，并请他推荐一个不太辣（mild）但又能尝到当地风味的口味。

tgt: While the TP report sets the framework, we perform sampling to ensure the actual transactions align with the documented policy.
We have selected these 20 samples to test the consistency of the pricing mechanism across different jurisdictions.
The sample size is determined based on the transaction volume and our assessed risk level for related party balances.
traps: 将‘公允’说成 'fair price'，专业审计语境通常用 'arm's length basis'。
用 'test the TP report is true or not' 语气太重，应说 'verify the implementation of the policy'。
错误使用 'check every money'，应使用 'substantive testing of individual transactions'。
aud_samp_related_party.ai: Alex 是集团司库。他认为 TP Report 已经由税务专家出具，审计只需要看大数，不需要抽取具体的发票和支付凭证来验证每一笔的利率或定价。
aud_samp_related_party.task: 阐明 TP Report 是政策层面，审计抽样是为了验证政策在实际交易层面是否被一贯执行。

tgt: The safety seal on this eyedrop bottle is still completely intact.
I paid extra for medical care, but it seems my instructions were totally ignored.
I need you to check the logbook and security footage to see what actually happened.
traps: 把“封条完好”直译为 "the bottle sign is complete"，地道表达是 "the seal is intact" 或 "it hasn't been opened"。
想表达“忽略了我的要求”，错说成 "ignore my speaking"，地道说法是 "ignored my instructions" 或 "disregarded my requests"。
表达“监控录像”说成 "CCTV video"，更常用的地道词汇是 "security footage" 或 "surveillance footage"。
hob_pet_akl_boarding_eyedrops.ai: Alex 扮演宠物酒店接待员。他坚称员工按时给狗滴了药，可能是用了店里的备用药或拿错了药瓶，试图轻描淡写化解问题。
hob_pet_akl_boarding_eyedrops.task: 拿出未开封的药瓶作为证据，表达对宠物健康受损的担忧，要求核查监控并退还护理费与寄养费。

tgt: I'm checking on my subscription box—it's three days overdue, and I haven't received an update.
I really need this for a gift; is there any way to expedite it or track the current status?
If it's going to be delayed much longer, I might need to consider a refund.
traps: Avoid 'You guys are useless at shipping'—too personal. Say 'I'm checking on my subscription...' to remain professional.
Avoid 'I want my money back right now'—too aggressive. Use 'I might need to consider a refund' as a future option.
Avoid 'Where is my stuff?'—too informal and rude. Use 'I haven't received an update' to report the facts.
hob_coffee_tea_subscription_delay.ai: Alex是店里的经理，他对物流系统出现的积压感到无能为力，有些推卸责任。
hob_coffee_tea_subscription_delay.task: 在不发火的前提下，要求对方给出一个准确的送达时间或退款选项。

tgt: Which of these two sakes would pair better with the grilled fish?
This one has a remarkably delicate and floral nose.
I prefer a slightly drier sake with less residual sweetness.
traps: 问哪款酒更适合搭配说成 'Which wine is good for eat fish?'，语法和词汇全错，应为 'Which of these pairs better with fish?'
形容酒有花香说成 'smell like flower'，不地道，应说 'has a delicate floral aroma' 或 'floral notes'。
说自己喜欢干一点的清酒说成 'I like dry sake, not sweet'，可以但不够高级，地道说法是 'I prefer a drier style with less residual sugar'。
hob_wine_sommelier_selection.ai: Alex 扮演日式居酒屋的清酒侍酒师，他用流利的英语向你解释其中一款酒体更轻盈、带有花香。
hob_wine_sommelier_selection.task: 向侍酒师询问这两款清酒更适合搭配刺身还是烤物。

tgt: I just watched a movie in Theater 4 and I forgot my umbrella there.
It's a long black Burberry umbrella, leaning against seat 8J.
Has anyone turned it in to the Lost and Found?
traps: 不要把‘长柄伞’说成 long umbrella，地道说法是 stick umbrella 或 full-size umbrella。
不要说 Where is my umbrella?，显得对方有义务替你看着。地道问法是 Has anyone found an umbrella? 或 Did anyone turn in an umbrella?
电影院的‘厅’不要说 room，要用 theater 或 screen。
life_lost_nyc_cinema.ai: Alex 是电影院的前台接待。他愿意帮忙查看失物招领箱，或者进场帮你找，但他需要确认你的放映厅和座位号。
life_lost_nyc_cinema.task: 告知前台你落下的具体物品、放映厅号和座位位置。

tgt: I tried restarting the screen, but the GPS still cannot get a signal.
Could you check if the navigation system needs a map update or if I can swap cars?
Since this GPS isn't working, can you provide a portable GPS unit instead?
traps: 说 'The GPS is broken down'。动词搭配错误，应该是 'The GPS has broken down' 或 'The GPS is not working'。
问 'Can you change another car for me?' 是典型的中式英语。地道说法是 'Can I swap this car for another one?' 或 'Can I get a replacement vehicle?'。
说 'I need you to give me a small machine'。地道说法是 'portable GPS unit' 或 'handheld GPS'。
talk_car_rental_gps_issue.ai: Alex 扮演租车公司的现场交车专员。他会走到车旁帮你重启车机系统，并解释可能是因为地下车库刚出来信号还没刷新。
talk_car_rental_gps_issue.task: 告知重启后依然无法使用，并要求换一辆导航正常的车或者提供备用方案。

tgt: Bureaucracy definitely slows things down, but it also mitigates huge risks.
In 9M26, we're seeing more internal incubators to bypass red tape.
It's hard to stay nimble when you're managing huge scale.
traps: 把「繁文缛节/官僚流程」说成 "too many complex rules"，地道说法是 "red tape" 或 "bureaucracy"。
想说「保持灵活」错用 "keep fast and quick"，地道表达是 "stay nimble" 或 "stay agile"。
表达「规避/减轻风险」直译为 "avoid risk happening"，地道用法是 "mitigate risk" 或 "hedge against risk"。
talk_work_austin_farmers_market.ai: Alex 热情开朗，注重实际接地气的商业逻辑。他会从创业者的角度提出一些针锋相对的问题，如「大公司层层审批，创新难道不会被扼杀吗」。
talk_work_austin_farmers_market.task: 解释大机构或你所在行业在创新与流程管控之间的平衡，用通俗地道的语言解惑。

tgt: Is it okay if I do some gentle stretching here in the pool?
I want to make sure I'm not violating any wellness etiquette.
Which area would be the best place to do this without bothering others?
traps: 不要说 'Can I do sports here?'，瑜伽/拉伸不叫 'sports'，用 'gentle stretching' 更加准确温和。
不要直译 'Is it polite?'，询问是否符合规则地道的说法是 'Is it against the rules?' 或 'Am I violating any etiquette?'。
不要说 'I won't play water'，地道地表达“不溅水”应该用 'I won't make a splash'。
hob_yoga_reykjavik_spa.ai: Alex 是温泉池的管理员。他很友善，表示只要你不溅起水花、不占用主通道、不打扰到其他泡汤的客人，做一些温和的拉伸是完全可以的。
hob_yoga_reykjavik_spa.task: 询问 Alex 在温泉池里做些温和的、不激烈的拉伸动作是否被允许，并确认哪个区域最适合做这些。
